blocks.title: Wholesale Travertine Blocks
blocks.name: blocks
blocks.intro: Majen supplies Turkish travertine blocks in Blaundos Antiko, Light, and Ivory varieties. Extracted from our Uşak–Ulubey quarry, blocks average 280×220×200 cm and weigh 30–35 tons. With reinforced packaging and container-ready preparation, these blocks are export-ready for factories and wholesalers worldwide. Importers rely on Majen’s quarry-direct Usak travertine supply, consistent quality, and reliable FOB/CIF shipping options for long-term projects.
blocks.intro2: Turkish travertine blocks from Usak are preferred by global importers for durability, size, and versatility. Direct quarry sourcing ensures uniform texture and A-grade quality, while certified inspections guarantee reliability. Whether destined for slab cutting, tile processing or custom designs, Majen provides stable supply with transparent logistics. Architects and wholesalers trust our blocks to meet international standards, combining natural beauty with efficient production.
description: High durability, natural beauty, and quarry-direct sourcing from Uşak–Ulubey make Majen blocks a trusted choice for Turkish travertine supply. Our blocks provide consistent texture, A-grade quality, and secure packaging for reliable international delivery.

Travertine blocks are primarily used for factory processing into slabs and tiles, bulk export distribution, and large-scale architectural projects. Offered in Blaundos Antiko, Light, and Ivory, our blocks meet the diverse needs of global importers and construction firms.

Standard block size is approx. 280×220×200 cm, with natural quarry faces and an average weight of 30–35 tons. Bulk orders are export-ready and reinforced for container loading, ensuring safe handling during international shipments.

Blocks are supplied with natural/raw surfaces (wire-cut) straight from the quarry. For export, reinforced wooden frames, nylon wrapping, and metal strapping are applied, minimizing risk and ensuring that travertine blocks arrive safely worldwide.

variants.heading: Travertine Block Varieties
variants.text: We supply three exclusive Turkish travertine block varieties: Blaundos Antiko (grey-beige antique tones), Blaundos Light (light beige), and Blaundos Ivory (ivory-cream). These blocks are primarily delivered with natural quarry surfaces, ready for slab cutting or custom processing. Each variety provides distinct tones for luxury facades, interiors, or large-scale commercial projects. With flexible finishes available upon request, Majen ensures adaptability for diverse architectural needs.

TextSection.text1: Block orders are selected around the buyer’s gang-saw or block-cutter capacity. Dimensions, estimated tonnage and loading sequence are recorded before dispatch, and weight distribution is considered when each block is secured inside the container. Processing plants can therefore place an arriving lot directly into a realistic production schedule.
TextSection.text2: Block grading considers more than color: fracture direction, vein continuity, void structure and expected slab recovery are reviewed together. Blocks assigned to one production lot are compared for visual compatibility. This selection helps reduce unexpected breakage and low-yield cutting at the factory.
TextSection.header3: Raw Material for Slab and Tile Lines
TextSection.text3: Travertine blocks are feedstock for downstream slab and tile production rather than finished coverings. Antiko supports more expressive, antique collections, while Light and Ivory suit quieter pale ranges. Manufacturers can use these distinctions to develop finishes and dimensions for their own target markets.
TextSection.header4: Recurring Block Programs and Quarry Visibility
TextSection.text4: Majen focuses on repeat raw-material programs as well as individual loads. Quarry availability, suitable block count and estimated tonnage are shared ahead of loading. This visibility helps importers coordinate saw capacity, stock levels and the timing of their next container.
TextSection.subtext1: Average block size is 280×220×200 cm with natural surfaces. Export-ready, suitable for bulk orders, with reinforced packaging for container loading.
TextSection.subtext2: Block integrity and vein direction are assessed against the usable slab volume expected from gang-saw cutting.
TextSection.subtext3: Blocks in one shipment are grouped for compatible color, pore structure and visual movement.
TextSection.subtext4: Tonnage and center of gravity guide the use of timber supports and steel restraints inside the container.

ivory.metaDesc: High-gloss luxury look with bright ivory tone.
ivory.h1: Ivory Travertine Blocks
ivory.title: Ivory Travertine Blocks
ivory.intro: Ivory Travertine Blocks are extracted from the finest quarries in Turkey, known for their warm beige color and uniform structure. These natural stone blocks are the ideal raw material for high-end architectural and construction projects worldwide. Whether you’re producing slabs, tiles or cut‑to‑size panels, Majen’s premium travertine guarantees durability, elegance, and color consistency. With direct quarry access and global export logistics, we ensure top quality and reliable supply for every order.
ivory.intro2: Ivory Travertine Blocks are widely used across luxury villas, hotel facades, shopping centers, and public buildings thanks to their timeless tone and balanced veining. Indoors, they suit floors, wall cladding, staircases, and feature walls where warmth and light reflection are desired. Outdoors, the stone enhances pool decks, garden paths, and exterior cladding with its natural slip resistance and weather tolerance. Its stability across temperature shifts makes it reliable in both hot and continental climates. Majen supplies blocks optimized for multiple finishes — honed, polished, brushed, tumbled — to match every aesthetic and technical requirement.
ivory.text3: Ivory Travertine Blocks are selected according to block size, color grade, extraction quality, and project scope. Freight terms, packing type, and requested certifications can also shape the supply plan. Majen supports buyers with clear material selection, batch coordination, and quarry-direct allocation for reliable long-term supply.
ivory.h4: Travertine Block Sizes & Standard Dimensions
ivory.text4: Standard quarry‑run blocks are typically available up to *3.2 m × 2.0 m × 1.6 m*, subject to bench conditions. Each block is measured, coded, and inspected before loading to ensure dimensional accuracy and optimal yield during slab production. Consistent sizing simplifies nesting and reduces waste in fabrication lines. Whether you need large‑format cladding or smaller architectural details, Majen offers flexible cutting options and batch grouping by tone and vein to maintain aesthetic continuity across projects.
ivory.h5: Travertine Blocks vs Slabs: Which Is Right for You?
ivory.text5: Choose blocks when you need maximum flexibility, better material yield control, and planning efficiency at scale — ideal for quarries, processors, and distributors. Choose *slabs* when you require ready‑to‑install surfaces and faster turnaround for small to medium projects. Blocks minimize material yield in large fabrication workflows, while slabs reduce on‑site complexity. Majen provides both supply modes so you can balance budget, lead time, and customization based on your production setup and project timeline.

antico.title: Ivory Travertine Blocks
antico.intro: Antico Travertine Blocks are extracted from Turkey’s premium quarries, featuring a distinctive mix of beige, Antico, and cream tones with expressive natural veining. This ancient‑looking travertine offers a rustic and historic feel while maintaining modern durability. Perfect for restoration, classic architecture, and landscape design, Antico Travertine combines traditional character with long‑lasting strength. With Majen’s direct quarry sourcing and global export experience, every block is carefully inspected, graded, and shipped with full documentation and tone consistency.
antico.intro2: Antico Travertine Blocks are highly sought after for restoration projects, heritage buildings, and luxury architectural designs seeking a timeless aesthetic. Indoors, they add warmth and texture to lobbies, staircases, and wall claddings, offering a natural patina that evolves beautifully over time. Outdoors, this stone is ideal for facades, courtyards, pool decks, and garden walls where antique charm meets strength and slip resistance. The stone’s earthy color palette harmonizes with Mediterranean, rustic, and contemporary architectural styles alike, making it one of the most versatile choices for designers and builders.
antico.text3: Antico Travertine Blocks are selected according to size, tone depth, quarry selection, and project scope. Color intensity, veining distribution, and processing expectations help define the right block program for each order. Majen coordinates quarry selection, logistics, and certifications through a clear quarry-direct supply process.
antico.h4: Travertine Block Sizes & Standard Dimensions
antico.text4: Standard Antico Travertine Blocks are available in sizes up to 3.2 m × 2.0 m × 1.6 m, with smaller or custom‑cut formats available upon request. Each block is tone‑graded, dimension‑checked, and coded for full traceability. Consistency in block size improves yield during slab or tile production, minimizing waste and ensuring efficient cutting. Majen provides custom batch matching for projects requiring continuity of tone and texture, allowing architects and contractors to achieve seamless visual results across both interior and exterior applications.
antico.h5: Travertine Blocks vs Slabs: Which Fits Your Workflow?

Slabs, however, are suitable for ready‑to‑install projects where time and size predictability are critical. For Antico Travertine, blocks preserve the natural raw texture that enhances its antique character, while slabs deliver a refined and polished version of the same tone. Majen supplies both, offering clients the freedom to choose based on project scale and finish preference.

unfilled-honed.h1: What defines unfilled brushed cross cut travertine?
unfilled-honed.title: What defines unfilled brushed cross cut travertine?
unfilled-honed.lead: It combines open natural pores with a soft, brushed surface and cloudy cross-cut patterns for natural depth and texture.
unfilled-honed.intro: It combines open natural pores with a soft, brushed surface and cloudy cross-cut patterns for natural depth and texture.
unfilled-honed.title2: What Is Unfilled Honed Vein Cut Travertine?
unfilled-honed.intro2: “Vein Cut” exposes the stone’s natural layers, producing linear vein patterns that flow across each slab. “Unfilled” means the pores remain open, preserving texture and breathability. “Honed” refines the surface to a smooth, low-gloss finish without filling the pores—balancing natural roughness with refined aesthetics. This combination provides understated elegance with tactile comfort and timeless authenticity.

detailsHeadings.title1: Why Our Unfilled Honed Vein Cut?

Ivory delivers bright cream warmth; Light offers subtle beige neutrality; Antico adds earthy depth with classic charm. Each tone comes from the same quarry level to ensure consistent hue and vein direction across large spaces. These natural colors emphasize the stone’s organic rhythm and are perfect for balanced, modern environments.

description: Linear veins, open-pore texture, and soft matte finish. A perfect balance of authenticity and refinement—crafted directly at the source in Uşak–Ulubey.
Available in Ivory, Light, and Antico tones. Each tone delivers unique character while maintaining color consistency and vein harmony.
Available in 2 cm, 3 cm, and 5 cm, with precise calibration for tight joints and easy installation. Large slabs maintain vein flow and reduce layout waste.
Primary finish: Honed with unfilled natural pores. Slabs are securely strapped and packed in reinforced wooden crates for safe international shipment.

TextSection.header1: Advantages of the Unfilled Honed Finish on Vein Cut Slabs
TextSection.text1: The unfilled honed finish merges natural authenticity with refined smoothness. The open pores express the material’s origin, while the honed surface enhances comfort and easy cleaning. It provides a matte, low-glare aesthetic ideal for serene interiors and softly illuminated spaces. Majen’s precision calibration ensures a consistent surface feel without losing the natural vein definition that defines Vein Cut Travertine.
TextSection.text2: Use Unfilled Honed Vein Cut Travertine Slabs for wall cladding, living spaces, spa zones, and indoor-outdoor transitions. Its balanced matte texture pairs beautifully with wood, concrete, and glass elements. Architects prefer this finish for projects seeking natural sophistication without shine. Combine with brushed or polished travertine in connected areas to add subtle contrast while maintaining design continuity.
TextSection.text3: Produced in 2 cm, 3 cm, and 5 cm thicknesses. Large-format slabs enhance vein continuity and visual calm across spaces. Surfaces are precisely calibrated and honed without closing the pores, keeping the natural breathability of travertine intact. Fabrication advice: align veins for directional balance, use breathable sealers, and avoid resin coatings to preserve texture authenticity.
TextSection.header4: Why Choose Majen for Unfilled Honed Vein Cut Travertine?
TextSection.text4: Majen directly controls quarrying, cutting, and finishing, ensuring unmatched quality consistency. Each slab is hand-inspected for vein alignment, tone grouping, and precise honing. Orders are shipped with full documentation, reinforced wooden crates, and moisture protection under FOB or CIF terms. With a proven export record, Majen provides reliable service and long-term material availability for international projects.
TextSection.text5: Majen exports Unfilled Honed Vein Cut Travertine Slabs to Europe, North America, and the Middle East. All slabs meet ISO standards for thickness, flatness, and surface quality. Routine maintenance requires mild, pH-neutral cleaners and optional breathable sealers. The honed surface gently ages over time, enhancing the natural tone variation that defines authentic travertine aesthetics.

filled-honed.intro2: “Vein cut” emphasizes linear bands that flow across the slab; “filled” closes open voids for stability and easy cleaning; “honed” calibrates the surface to a silky, low-gloss sheen. variants.title: Color Options: Ivory, Light, and Antico
variants.text: To match different design palettes, Majen offers Ivory, Light, and Antico tones. Ivory delivers warm cream elegance with gentle, continuous veining; Light provides a neutral beige ideal for minimal interiors; Antico offers a slightly deeper, earthy character for richer contrasts. All colors are curated from the same quarry bench to keep hue and pattern continuity across large areas, enabling vein matching and seamless book-look layouts on walls and floors.

description: Quarry-direct slabs with clear linear veins, professional filling, and premium honing. Tight calibration, color grouping, and export-ready reinforcement deliver predictable, A-grade results.
Choose Ivory, Light or Antico to match warm, neutral or deeper palettes. Curated from the same bench for reliable hue harmony and vein continuity across large spaces.
Produced in 2 cm, 3 cm, 5 cm with large-format availability. Flatness and thickness tolerances speed installation and improve vein alignment on floors and walls.
Primary finish: Honed (matte). Alternative accents available on request. Slabs ship in reinforced wooden crates with moisture protection for safe, long-distance freight.

TextSection.header1: Advantages of Filled + Honed for Vein Cut Slabs
TextSection.text1: Filling increases density, hygiene, and edge strength, while the honed finish ensures comfortable foot feel, low maintenance, and controlled reflection under strong lighting. Combined with linear veins, spaces gain rhythm without glare—perfect for hotels, showrooms, and residential galleries. The matte look softens daylight and artificial light equally, and keeps photography true-to-color. Majen’s calibration limits lippage and speeds installation on expansive floors.
TextSection.text2: Use Filled Honed Vein Cut slabs for interior floors, lobby corridors, wall cladding, stair strings, reception desks, and elevator surrounds. Pair with brushed tiles in adjacent wet areas for texture continuity or contrast with polished accents on countertops. Linear veins guide circulation in long spaces and emphasize perspective in galleries. Coordinated thresholds and skirtings are available cut-to-size to maintain material language throughout the project.
TextSection.text3: Standard thicknesses are 2 cm, 3 cm, and 5 cm with tight tolerance. Large formats improve layout speed and reduce grout lines; edges are square-cut and micro-beveled on request. Slabs are reinforced where necessary, then inspected for flatness and color grouping before packing. Fabrication notes: align veins along the main axis of movement; pre-dry-lay for book-flow effects; use color-matched grout and flexible adhesives for heavy-use floors.
TextSection.header4: Why Choose Majen for Filled Honed Vein Cut Travertine?
TextSection.text4: As a direct quarry supplier, Majen controls block selection, cutting, filling, honing, and final QC in one workflow. Orders ship under FOB or CIF with packing lists, invoices, and certificates of origin. Crates are strapped, wrapped, and corner-guarded for ocean freight. Dedicated export support, reliable inventory, and responsive sampling help architects and importers deliver on schedule while preserving the design intent of continuous, elegant vein movement.
TextSection.text5: Majen exports to Europe, North America, and the Middle East, meeting international tolerances for thickness, flatness, and surface finish. For care, use pH-neutral cleaners and reseal as specified by traffic level; the filled honed surface resists staining and cleans easily. Technical data sheets and recommended sealers are available on request. With steady production and consistent tonality, Majen supports repeat projects and long-term sourcing programs.

antiko.title: Wholesale Travertine Blocks Blaundos Antico
antiko.intro: Blaundos Antico travertine is a warm, beige-toned stone with antique character and subtle movement that suits both classic and contemporary designs. Sourced directly from our Uşak–Ulubey region, Majen supplies wholesale slabs with consistent grading, reliable lead times, and reinforced packaging for export. Architects, importers, and contractors choose this variety for durable floors, facades, countertops, and bespoke interior features, achieving timeless elegance with dependable performance across residential and commercial projects.
antiko.alt: Wholesale Blaundos Antiko travertine blocks from Turkey
antiko.title2: Why Choose Blaundos Antico Travertine Blocks?
antiko.intro2: Blaundos Antico stands out for its earthy palette, nuanced veining, and antique texture that adds depth without overpowering a space. Its density and calibrated finishes support heavy-traffic areas while remaining easy to maintain. With quarry-direct sourcing, Majen controls selection and grading, ensuring predictable results at scale. reliable supply, flexible MOQs, and project-matched lots help streamline specifications. For large orders, we provide sample boards and detailed QC reports, enabling confident decisions for global builds.
description: Why choose Blaundos Antiko slabs: antique-inspired look, expressive veining, bookmatch options and strong continuity on large surfaces. Excellent balance of authenticity and durability for premium interiors.

Sourced and processed in Uşak–Ulubey. Used in island countertops, bathroom vanities, reception desks, wall cladding, elevator surrounds and luxury retail fixtures. Shade-verified lots for consistent project outcomes.

cards.text1: From luxury hospitality to private villas, Blaundos Antico adapts to varied aesthetics. Its neutral warmth pairs well with wood, metal, and glass, allowing cohesive palettes in mixed-material schemes. Designers value its ability to soften minimal interiors or enrich traditional settings with organic texture. Available finishes expand possibilities, from refined polished looks to tactile brushed or tumbled surfaces ideal for outdoor paths and pool surrounds. The result is a reliable, elegant stone that elevates spaces without visual noise.
cards.text2: Calibrated thickness, consistent flatness, and suitable surface treatments help Blaundos Antico perform in lobbies, corridors, and retail zones. Anti-slip options support safety outdoors, while proper sealing enhances stain resistance indoors. With accurate cutting and tight tolerances, installers achieve clean joints and level surfaces, reducing rework and time on site. This blend of aesthetics and practicality positions Blaundos Antico as a proven specification for demanding, design-driven environments across climates and usage patterns.

ApplicationSection.title: Applications of Blaundos Antico Travertine Slabs
ApplicationSection.text: Blaundos Antico is specified for floors, wall cladding, countertops, fireplace surrounds, stair treads, and exterior facades. Its antique texture lends character to boutique hotels and residences, while honed or polished finishes suit refined interiors. Outdoors, brushed or tumbled slabs complement landscaping, garden paths, and pool decks. The stone’s tonal stability supports continuity between inside and outside, helping designers create cohesive transitions. With accurate sizing and reliable supply, it scales from small renovations to flagship builds.
ApplicationSection.subtitle: Interior & Exterior Use Cases
ApplicationSection.subtext: Indoors, Blaundos Antico brings warmth to living areas and statement value to feature walls or reception desks. In kitchens and baths, sealed surfaces provide practical durability with natural beauty. Externally, its weathered look enriches patios and facades, aging gracefully over time. For public spaces, coordinated formats (slabs, tiles, custom pieces) keep design language consistent. Majen’s technical support advises on finish selection, slip ratings, and maintenance to match climate, footfall, and performance requirements.

AvailableSection.title: Available Sizes & Thickness
AvailableSection.text: Majen supplies slabs commonly at 2 cm and 3 cm thickness, cut from blocks selected for tone and structure. Custom dimensions can be produced on request, including book-matched sets for feature walls. Tight calibration and precision polishing ensure flatness and clean edges that speed installation. For special elements—vanities, stair treads or oversized cladding—our team provides cut-to-size options that maintain vein continuity. Consistent sizing across batches supports predictable waste rates and accurate take-offs.
AvailableSection.subtitle: Dimensional Tolerances
AvailableSection.subtext: Slab thickness is controlled within industry tolerances to support even load distribution and dependable adhesion. Surface regularity reduces lippage risk on large floors, while square edges and stable geometry help installers achieve fine joints in visual-critical areas. For ventilated facades and lightweight assemblies, we coordinate with fabricators to meet bracket and anchor constraints. All dimensions are verified at dispatch, and reports are available for documentation and submittal packages when required.

FinishesSection.title: Finishes & Packaging Options
FinishesSection.text: Blaundos Antico can be supplied polished, honed, brushed or tumbled to align with design intent and slip resistance needs. Finishes are applied with calibrated equipment to keep tone and sheen consistent across lots. For export, slabs are packed in reinforced wooden bundles with corner guards, interleaves, and strapping that limits movement in transit. Moisture-resistant wrapping and clear labeling aid handling at ports and job sites. Packaging is optimized for container loading to minimize risk and freight costs.
FinishesSection.subtitle: Surface Finish Guidance
FinishesSection.subtext: Select polished for premium interiors, honed for low-glare sophistication, brushed where texture is desired, and tumbled for rustic, outdoor-ready charm. In wet areas or exterior paths, combine texture with appropriate sealers to improve maintenance and slip performance. We can supply matched samples across finishes so teams preview appearance under project lighting. This process helps align expectations early, reducing change orders and helping stakeholders approve materials quickly and confidently.
FinishesSection.subtext2: Each bundle is photographed and measured prior to loading. Straps, braces, and internal blocking limit vibration, while protective interlayers reduce abrasion. Bundle IDs map to packing lists for fast checks at customs and on site. Shock indicators can be added on request. The goal is simple: slabs arrive installation-ready, with documentation that keeps receiving and quality verification efficient for importers and contractors.

PartnerSection.title: Why Partner with Majen for Travertine Slabs?
PartnerSection.description: Beyond quarry access, Majen offers technical guidance, flexible MOQs, and dependable lead times that fit real-world schedules. Direct sourcing keeps costs predictable and ensures tone matching across lots. Reinforced packaging, thorough documentation, and responsive support reduce friction during shipping and receiving. We build long-term relationships with importers, distributors, and contractors, providing post-delivery assistance and repeatable quality so projects finish on brief, on schedule, and on time.
PartnerSection.text1: From sampling and mock-ups to installation advice, our team responds quickly with practical guidance. Multilingual communication, transparent timelines, and after-sales follow-up help keep stakeholders aligned. Whether you need book-matched features, custom cuts or coordinated tiles, we manage details and share progress so decisions stay informed.
PartnerSection.text2: We prioritize responsible quarrying, water recycling, and waste reduction. Material traceability and documentation support green building goals and client ESG policies. These practices contribute to durable, long-life installations with lower lifecycle impact.
PartnerSection.text3: We provide packing data, certificates of origin, and HS codes; optional lab tests and slip ratings can be arranged. This documentation simplifies import processes and supports submittals for architects and contractors, helping approvals proceed without delays.

TextSection.text1: Explore complementary selections that pair well with Blaundos Antico. Each variety offers distinct tone and movement for different design intents, enabling cohesive palettes across floors, walls, and facades. Discover Blaundos Light Slabs for brighter schemes and Blaundos Ivory Slabs for creamy warmth. Coordinate with Travertine Tiles or Travertine Blocks to extend the language of natural stone through interiors, exteriors, and custom elements while keeping sourcing streamlined under one partner.
TextSection.text2: Ideal for kitchen islands, vanities and lobby walls. Pair with vein-cut bookmatch for dramatic continuity; specify 20–30 mm for interiors, 30+ mm for high-stress zones.
TextSection.text3: Reinforced A-frames, corner and moisture protection, photo-documented loading and shared seal numbers. FOB İzmir or CIF to major ports.

slabs.intro: Majen supplies Turkish travertine slabs in 2 cm, 3 cm, and 5 cm thicknesses directly from our Uşak–Ulubey quarry. Available in Blaundos Antiko, Light, and Ivory, our slabs are selected for consistency, durability, and natural elegance. Each slab is carefully cut and inspected to meet A-grade standards, reinforced for international shipment, and trusted by architects and wholesalers worldwide.
slabs.intro2: Turkey is one of the world’s leading sources of travertine, and Majen delivers premium selections. Our slabs offer polished, honed, brushed, and tumbled finishes to suit diverse projects. Quarry-direct sourcing ensures consistent supply and reliable supply. Importers and designers rely on Majen slabs for residential, commercial, and hospitality projects requiring both strength and timeless beauty.

cuts.heading: Travertine Slabs Cut Options
cuts.text: Majen offers two distinct cutting methods for Travertine Slabs — Vein Cut and Cross Cut Each option highlights unique patterns and tones, crafted to meet diverse architectural needs. Choose honed for smooth elegance, brushed or tumbled for rustic texture, and polished for luxury interiors.

vein-cut.title: Vein Cut Travertine Slabs
vein-cut.intro: Majen supplies Vein Cut Travertine Slabs sourced directly from our Uşak–Ulubey quarry in Turkey. Each slab showcases elegant linear veins that flow naturally across the surface, creating a refined architectural look ideal for interior walls, flooring, and large commercial projects. With precise cutting, consistent coloration, and global FOB/CIF export options, Majen ensures superior quality and timeless stone aesthetics for international buyers.
vein-cut.intro2: Vein Cut Travertine is produced by slicing the stone parallel to its natural bedding layers, revealing continuous linear veins. This technique creates a directional pattern that enhances architectural balance and spatial continuity. Ideal for modern interiors, facades, and commercial flooring, these slabs combine elegance and durability with consistent coloration and smooth finishing. Majen’s quarry-direct sourcing ensures reliable quality and sustainable export standards.

variants.title: Filled and Unfilled Surface Options
variants.text: Majen’s Vein Cut Travertine Slabs are available in filled and unfilled varieties to match different design needs. Filled slabs are treated with resin or cement for dense, polished surfaces ideal for luxury interiors. Unfilled slabs preserve natural pores, showcasing authentic texture preferred for rustic and outdoor spaces. Every slab is meticulously inspected, reinforced, and documented before shipment to guarantee flawless international delivery.

vein-cut.desc: Vein Cut Travertine Slabs reveal the natural linear veins of the stone, creating a striking, continuous flow across surfaces. Ideal for wall cladding, flooring, and large-format designs that emphasize movement and depth.

TextSection.text1: Choose from honed polished, brushed or tumbled finishes to achieve your project’s design goals. Honed surfaces offer a smooth matte appearance, while polished finishes reflect light for a luxurious feel. Brushed and tumbled options enhance texture, providing natural slip resistance and aged aesthetics. Each finish is produced with Majen’s advanced machinery and strict surface calibration standards.
TextSection.header2: Advantages of Vein Cut Travertine Slabs
TextSection.text2: Vein Cut Travertine highlights continuous linear veins that create a sense of movement and visual depth. This directional flow brings dynamic elegance to hotel lobbies, long corridors, and modern architecture. Beyond aesthetics, the stone provides exceptional structural integrity, consistent patterning, and natural insulation. Majen carefully selects blocks with uniform tones, ensuring reliable color matching across large-scale installations.

Their linear pattern makes them ideal for projects emphasizing continuity, symmetry, and spatial harmony. Designers prefer these slabs in both contemporary and classical environments, achieving timeless visual depth with natural stone warmth.

We provide FOB and CIF shipping terms, complete export documentation, and reinforced wooden crate packaging. With dedicated service and long-term reliability, Majen is trusted by architects, importers, and stone distributors worldwide.

QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq_span1: Vein Cut Travertine Slabs

Natural Face: Raw matte topography retains subtle relief and low reflectance for calm visual fields. Vein Cut: Parallel slicing to bedding reveals orderly linear veining that guides sightlines and accentuates proportion. Unfilled vs Filled: Unfilled maximizes natural texture and breathability; filled delivers smoother, easier‑to‑clean surfaces. Choose unfilled for statement walls and covered exteriors; select filled for bathrooms or high‑maintenance zones requiring closed pores.

tiles.title: Wholesale Travertine Tiles
tiles.name: tiles
tiles.intro: Majen travertine tiles are prepared for modular floor and wall applications in vein-cut and cross-cut patterns, Blaundos Antiko, Light and Ivory colours, and a range of surface finishes. Square, rectangular, large-format and Versailles modules can be coordinated around the project layout. Size distribution, finish, shade range and crate organization are reviewed together for each order.
tiles.intro2: Travertine tile combines the colour and pore variation of natural stone with repeatable modular formats. It can be specified for interior floors, walls, bathrooms, hospitality and retail environments, and—when the product and installation system are properly selected—for exterior terraces and pool surrounds. Wet or exterior suitability must be assessed from stone test data, substrate, drainage, waterproofing, adhesive and movement-joint design rather than from the finish name alone.
description: Size, squareness, thickness calibration, edge accuracy and finish consistency are checked by production lot. Natural shade and pore variation are managed through the project blending plan rather than treated as defects.

Travertine tiles provide a modular natural-stone surface for interior floors, walls, bathrooms, lobbies and retail spaces. Exterior and wet-area use requires project-specific verification of performance and the complete installation system.

The catalogue includes 8×8, 12×12, 12×24, 16×16, 18×18, 24×24, 24×48 and 48×110 formats, plus the Versailles set. Available thickness and tolerances are confirmed for the intended application before ordering.

Natural, honed, polished, brushed and tumbled finishes create different visual and tactile results. Tiles are separated by size and lot and packed in export crates designed to protect faces and corners.

variants.heading: Travertine Tile Varieties
variants.text: Majen offers three main Turkish travertine tile varieties: Blaundos Antiko, Blaundos Light, and Blaundos Ivory. Each variety is cut and finished to highlight natural elegance and durability, then reinforced for secure sea freight, providing dependable material for importers and construction firms worldwide.

TextSection.text1: Order planning covers size distribution, laying pattern, cut orientation and spare allowance in addition to total area. Producing modules that will be installed together within a compatible shade range and separating size and quantity on crate labels simplifies site sequencing.
TextSection.text2: Thickness calibration, corner squareness, edge accuracy and finish are reviewed by lot. Because travertine is natural, shade and pore distribution should not be treated as uniform; dry laying or blending from several crates is recommended before installation.
TextSection.text3: Honed finishes create a restrained low-reflective surface, polished finishes a glossier expression, and brushed or tumbled finishes a more tactile texture. Slip, freeze-thaw, drainage and waterproofing requirements for wet or exterior locations must be verified by the project team.
TextSection.header4: Care and Installation Preparation
TextSection.text4: Travertine is calcium-carbonate based, so acidic or abrasive cleaners can etch or dull the surface. Neutral stone cleaners should be used. Where an impregnator is specified, it should be understood as improving stain resistance rather than making the stone stain-proof.
TextSection.subtext1: Square, rectangular and Versailles modules can be installed separately or combined around the room and joint layout.
TextSection.subtext2: Consistent thickness and squareness help reduce adhesive variation and lippage during installation.
TextSection.subtext3: Honed surfaces create a quiet interior look, while brushed and tumbled textures provide a more tactile outdoor surface.
TextSection.subtext4: Blending tiles from several crates before installation distributes travertine’s natural shade movement evenly across the floor.

vein-cut.title: Vein Cut Travertine Tiles
vein-cut.intro: Vein-cut travertine tiles are sawn parallel to the bedding, revealing linear bands and directional movement. Installed in one direction, modular tiles can create continuous flow; rotated selectively, they can form a more graphic composition.
vein-cut.title2: How Is the Vein Cut Tile Pattern Created?
vein-cut.intro2: Because the cutting plane follows the bedding, mineral layers appear as lines. Vein direction should be established in the laying plan and coordinated with crate sequencing.
vein-cut.desc: Modular travertine tiles with a linear vein direction.

TextSection.text1: Vein direction can reinforce length in corridors and may be laid consistently, staggered or selectively rotated in larger areas. Dry laying before installation makes line continuity and natural shade transitions easier to review.
TextSection.text2: Filled tiles create a more closed surface that is easier to clean, while unfilled options retain visible natural voids. Honed, polished, brushed, tumbled and natural finishes produce different responses to light and touch.
TextSection.text3: Suitability is not determined by pattern alone. Stone test data and finish must be assessed with traffic, substrate flatness, adhesive, grout, waterproofing, drainage and movement-joint design.
TextSection.header4: Care
TextSection.text4: Use a neutral cleaner for calcium-carbonate based travertine and avoid acidic or abrasive products. Any impregnator should be selected with the finish, location and product-manufacturer guidance in mind.

description: Size, squareness, thickness calibration, edge accuracy and finish consistency are checked by production lot. Natural shade and pore variation are managed through the project blending plan rather than treated as defects.

Travertine tiles provide a modular natural-stone surface for interior floors, walls, bathrooms, lobbies and retail spaces. Exterior and wet-area use requires project-specific verification of performance and the complete installation system.

The catalogue includes 8×8, 12×12, 12×24, 16×16, 18×18, 24×24, 24×48 and 48×110 formats, plus the Versailles set. Available thickness and tolerances are confirmed for the intended application before ordering.

Natural, honed, polished, brushed and tumbled finishes create different visual and tactile results. Tiles are separated by size and lot and packed in export crates designed to protect faces and corners.

unfilled-honed.h1: Unfilled Honed Vein Cut Travertine Tiles
unfilled-honed.title: Unfilled Honed Vein Cut Travertine Tiles
unfilled-honed.lead: Linear vein movement, an unfilled pore structure and a honed finish in a modular tile format.
unfilled-honed.intro: Unfilled Honed Vein Cut Travertine Tiles combines linear vein movement with visible natural pores. Honing creates a non-reflective, satin-matte appearance that presents the stone colour with restrained depth. Format, shade range and finish suitability are selected together for the project conditions.
unfilled-honed.title2: What Are Unfilled Honed Vein Cut Travertine Tiles?
unfilled-honed.intro2: Visible natural pores retain the characteristic voided structure of travertine. Whether voids remain open or are grouted during installation should be decided from the location and maintenance expectations. Honing creates a non-reflective, satin-matte appearance that presents the stone colour with restrained depth. Samples and technical performance data must be reviewed with the complete installation system for wet, exterior or heavy-use locations.

variants.title: Size and Colour Options
variants.text: This process can be planned in catalogue modules and Blaundos Ivory, Light and Antiko colours. Available combinations, shade range and production tolerances are confirmed before ordering.

description: Honing creates a non-reflective, satin-matte appearance that presents the stone colour with restrained depth.

Visible natural pores retain the characteristic voided structure of travertine. Whether voids remain open or are grouted during installation should be decided from the location and maintenance expectations.
Vein Cut production creates linear vein movement. Tile direction and pattern distribution can be reviewed through dry laying before installation.
Thickness, finish, filling, traffic and installation method should be selected together for the project; a finish name alone is not a performance guarantee for every location.

TextSection.text1: Unfilled Honed Vein Cut Travertine Tiles provide a modular natural-stone surface for interior floors, walls, bathrooms, lobbies and commercial spaces. Exterior and wet-area use should follow verification of stone test data and the complete installation system.
TextSection.text2: Honing creates a non-reflective, satin-matte appearance that presents the stone colour with restrained depth. Visible natural pores retain the characteristic voided structure of travertine. Whether voids remain open or are grouted during installation should be decided from the location and maintenance expectations.
TextSection.text3: Square, rectangular, large-format and Versailles modules are planned with the selected pattern direction. Blending from several crates before installation balances natural shade and pore movement.
TextSection.header4: Care and Protection
TextSection.text4: Use a pH-neutral natural-stone cleaner for routine care. Acids can etch travertine; an impregnator does not make stone stain-proof but may improve stain resistance when correctly selected.
TextSection.text5: Size, squareness, calibration, finish, filling and shade range are reviewed by production lot. Crate labels separate size and lot information to simplify stock and site distribution.

filled-honed.h1: Filled Honed Vein Cut Travertine Tiles
filled-honed.title: Filled Honed Vein Cut Travertine Tiles
filled-honed.lead: Linear vein movement, an filled pore structure and a honed finish in a modular tile format.
filled-honed.intro: Filled Honed Vein Cut Travertine Tiles combines linear vein movement with a more closed pore structure. Honing creates a non-reflective, satin-matte appearance that presents the stone colour with restrained depth. Format, shade range and finish suitability are selected together for the project conditions.
filled-honed.title2: What Are Filled Honed Vein Cut Travertine Tiles?
filled-honed.intro2: Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering. Honing creates a non-reflective, satin-matte appearance that presents the stone colour with restrained depth. Samples and technical performance data must be reviewed with the complete installation system for wet, exterior or heavy-use locations.

variants.title: Size and Colour Options
variants.text: This process can be planned in catalogue modules and Blaundos Ivory, Light and Antiko colours. Available combinations, shade range and production tolerances are confirmed before ordering.

description: Honing creates a non-reflective, satin-matte appearance that presents the stone colour with restrained depth.

Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering.
Vein Cut production creates linear vein movement. Tile direction and pattern distribution can be reviewed through dry laying before installation.
Thickness, finish, filling, traffic and installation method should be selected together for the project; a finish name alone is not a performance guarantee for every location.

TextSection.text1: Filled Honed Vein Cut Travertine Tiles provide a modular natural-stone surface for interior floors, walls, bathrooms, lobbies and commercial spaces. Exterior and wet-area use should follow verification of stone test data and the complete installation system.
TextSection.text2: Honing creates a non-reflective, satin-matte appearance that presents the stone colour with restrained depth. Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering.
TextSection.text3: Square, rectangular, large-format and Versailles modules are planned with the selected pattern direction. Blending from several crates before installation balances natural shade and pore movement.
TextSection.header4: Care and Protection
TextSection.text4: Use a pH-neutral natural-stone cleaner for routine care. Acids can etch travertine; an impregnator does not make stone stain-proof but may improve stain resistance when correctly selected.
TextSection.text5: Size, squareness, calibration, finish, filling and shade range are reviewed by production lot. Crate labels separate size and lot information to simplify stock and site distribution.

seo.title: Filled Polished Vein Cut Travertine Tiles | Majen
seo.description: Pattern, filling, finish, size, application and care information for filled polished vein cut travertine tiles.

filled-polished.h1: Filled Polished Vein Cut Travertine Tiles
filled-polished.title: Filled Polished Vein Cut Travertine Tiles
filled-polished.lead: Linear vein movement, an filled pore structure and a polished finish in a modular tile format.
filled-polished.intro: Filled Polished Vein Cut Travertine Tiles combines linear vein movement with a more closed pore structure. A glossy, highly reflective polished finish intensifies the colour and pattern contrast of travertine. Format, shade range and finish suitability are selected together for the project conditions.
filled-polished.title2: What Are Filled Polished Vein Cut Travertine Tiles?
filled-polished.intro2: Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering. A glossy, highly reflective polished finish intensifies the colour and pattern contrast of travertine. Samples and technical performance data must be reviewed with the complete installation system for wet, exterior or heavy-use locations.

variants.title: Size and Colour Options
variants.text: This process can be planned in catalogue modules and Blaundos Ivory, Light and Antiko colours. Available combinations, shade range and production tolerances are confirmed before ordering.

description: A glossy, highly reflective polished finish intensifies the colour and pattern contrast of travertine.

Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering.
Vein Cut production creates linear vein movement. Tile direction and pattern distribution can be reviewed through dry laying before installation.
Thickness, finish, filling, traffic and installation method should be selected together for the project; a finish name alone is not a performance guarantee for every location.

TextSection.text1: Filled Polished Vein Cut Travertine Tiles provide a modular natural-stone surface for interior floors, walls, bathrooms, lobbies and commercial spaces. Exterior and wet-area use should follow verification of stone test data and the complete installation system.
TextSection.text2: A glossy, highly reflective polished finish intensifies the colour and pattern contrast of travertine. Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering.
TextSection.text3: Square, rectangular, large-format and Versailles modules are planned with the selected pattern direction. Blending from several crates before installation balances natural shade and pore movement.
TextSection.header4: Care and Protection
TextSection.text4: Use a pH-neutral natural-stone cleaner for routine care. Acids can etch travertine; an impregnator does not make stone stain-proof but may improve stain resistance when correctly selected.
TextSection.text5: Size, squareness, calibration, finish, filling and shade range are reviewed by production lot. Crate labels separate size and lot information to simplify stock and site distribution.

seo.description: Pattern, filling, finish, size, application and care information for unfilled polished vein cut travertine tiles.

unfilled-polished.h1: Unfilled Polished Vein Cut Travertine Tiles
unfilled-polished.title: Unfilled Polished Vein Cut Travertine Tiles
unfilled-polished.lead: Linear vein movement, an unfilled pore structure and a polished finish in a modular tile format.
unfilled-polished.intro: Unfilled Polished Vein Cut Travertine Tiles combines linear vein movement with visible natural pores. A glossy, highly reflective polished finish intensifies the colour and pattern contrast of travertine. Format, shade range and finish suitability are selected together for the project conditions.
unfilled-polished.title2: What Are Unfilled Polished Vein Cut Travertine Tiles?
unfilled-polished.intro2: Visible natural pores retain the characteristic voided structure of travertine. Whether voids remain open or are grouted during installation should be decided from the location and maintenance expectations. A glossy, highly reflective polished finish intensifies the colour and pattern contrast of travertine. Samples and technical performance data must be reviewed with the complete installation system for wet, exterior or heavy-use locations.

variants.title: Size and Colour Options
variants.text: This process can be planned in catalogue modules and Blaundos Ivory, Light and Antiko colours. Available combinations, shade range and production tolerances are confirmed before ordering.

description: A glossy, highly reflective polished finish intensifies the colour and pattern contrast of travertine.

Visible natural pores retain the characteristic voided structure of travertine. Whether voids remain open or are grouted during installation should be decided from the location and maintenance expectations.
Vein Cut production creates linear vein movement. Tile direction and pattern distribution can be reviewed through dry laying before installation.
Thickness, finish, filling, traffic and installation method should be selected together for the project; a finish name alone is not a performance guarantee for every location.

TextSection.text1: Unfilled Polished Vein Cut Travertine Tiles provide a modular natural-stone surface for interior floors, walls, bathrooms, lobbies and commercial spaces. Exterior and wet-area use should follow verification of stone test data and the complete installation system.
TextSection.text2: A glossy, highly reflective polished finish intensifies the colour and pattern contrast of travertine. Visible natural pores retain the characteristic voided structure of travertine. Whether voids remain open or are grouted during installation should be decided from the location and maintenance expectations.
TextSection.text3: Square, rectangular, large-format and Versailles modules are planned with the selected pattern direction. Blending from several crates before installation balances natural shade and pore movement.
TextSection.header4: Care and Protection
TextSection.text4: Use a pH-neutral natural-stone cleaner for routine care. Acids can etch travertine; an impregnator does not make stone stain-proof but may improve stain resistance when correctly selected.
TextSection.text5: Size, squareness, calibration, finish, filling and shade range are reviewed by production lot. Crate labels separate size and lot information to simplify stock and site distribution.

QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq3_header: Can it be used in wet or exterior areas?
QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq3_text: Suitability must be assessed from samples and technical data together with substrate, waterproofing, drainage, adhesive, grout and movement-joint design.
QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq4_header: Which sizes are available?
QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq4_text: Catalogue modules and the Versailles set are offered. Exact thickness and tolerances are confirmed against the intended use before ordering.
QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq5_text: Use a pH-neutral natural-stone cleaner and avoid vinegar, lemon and other acidic or abrasive products.
QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq6_header: How should natural shade variation be managed?
QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq6_text: Dry lay and blend tiles from several crates before installation to distribute shade and pattern transitions across the surface.

filled-brushed.h1: Filled Brushed Vein Cut Travertine Tiles
filled-brushed.title: Filled Brushed Vein Cut Travertine Tiles
filled-brushed.lead: Linear vein movement, an filled pore structure and a brushed finish in a modular tile format.
filled-brushed.intro: Filled Brushed Vein Cut Travertine Tiles combines linear vein movement with a more closed pore structure. Abrasive brushing gives the surface light relief and a more tactile texture. Format, shade range and finish suitability are selected together for the project conditions.
filled-brushed.title2: What Are Filled Brushed Vein Cut Travertine Tiles?
filled-brushed.intro2: Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering. Abrasive brushing gives the surface light relief and a more tactile texture. Samples and technical performance data must be reviewed with the complete installation system for wet, exterior or heavy-use locations.

variants.title: Size and Colour Options
variants.text: This process can be planned in catalogue modules and Blaundos Ivory, Light and Antiko colours. Available combinations, shade range and production tolerances are confirmed before ordering.

description: Abrasive brushing gives the surface light relief and a more tactile texture.

Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering.
Vein Cut production creates linear vein movement. Tile direction and pattern distribution can be reviewed through dry laying before installation.
Thickness, finish, filling, traffic and installation method should be selected together for the project; a finish name alone is not a performance guarantee for every location.

TextSection.text1: Filled Brushed Vein Cut Travertine Tiles provide a modular natural-stone surface for interior floors, walls, bathrooms, lobbies and commercial spaces. Exterior and wet-area use should follow verification of stone test data and the complete installation system.
TextSection.text2: Abrasive brushing gives the surface light relief and a more tactile texture. Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering.
TextSection.text3: Square, rectangular, large-format and Versailles modules are planned with the selected pattern direction. Blending from several crates before installation balances natural shade and pore movement.
TextSection.header4: Care and Protection
TextSection.text4: Use a pH-neutral natural-stone cleaner for routine care. Acids can etch travertine; an impregnator does not make stone stain-proof but may improve stain resistance when correctly selected.
TextSection.text5: Size, squareness, calibration, finish, filling and shade range are reviewed by production lot. Crate labels separate size and lot information to simplify stock and site distribution.

unfilled-brushed.h1: Unfilled Brushed Vein Cut Travertine Tiles
unfilled-brushed.title: Unfilled Brushed Vein Cut Travertine Tiles
unfilled-brushed.lead: Linear vein movement, an unfilled pore structure and a brushed finish in a modular tile format.
unfilled-brushed.intro: Unfilled Brushed Vein Cut Travertine Tiles combines linear vein movement with visible natural pores. Abrasive brushing gives the surface light relief and a more tactile texture. Format, shade range and finish suitability are selected together for the project conditions.
unfilled-brushed.title2: What Are Unfilled Brushed Vein Cut Travertine Tiles?
unfilled-brushed.intro2: Visible natural pores retain the characteristic voided structure of travertine. Whether voids remain open or are grouted during installation should be decided from the location and maintenance expectations. Abrasive brushing gives the surface light relief and a more tactile texture. Samples and technical performance data must be reviewed with the complete installation system for wet, exterior or heavy-use locations.

variants.title: Size and Colour Options
variants.text: This process can be planned in catalogue modules and Blaundos Ivory, Light and Antiko colours. Available combinations, shade range and production tolerances are confirmed before ordering.

description: Abrasive brushing gives the surface light relief and a more tactile texture.

Visible natural pores retain the characteristic voided structure of travertine. Whether voids remain open or are grouted during installation should be decided from the location and maintenance expectations.
Vein Cut production creates linear vein movement. Tile direction and pattern distribution can be reviewed through dry laying before installation.
Thickness, finish, filling, traffic and installation method should be selected together for the project; a finish name alone is not a performance guarantee for every location.

TextSection.text1: Unfilled Brushed Vein Cut Travertine Tiles provide a modular natural-stone surface for interior floors, walls, bathrooms, lobbies and commercial spaces. Exterior and wet-area use should follow verification of stone test data and the complete installation system.
TextSection.text2: Abrasive brushing gives the surface light relief and a more tactile texture. Visible natural pores retain the characteristic voided structure of travertine. Whether voids remain open or are grouted during installation should be decided from the location and maintenance expectations.
TextSection.text3: Square, rectangular, large-format and Versailles modules are planned with the selected pattern direction. Blending from several crates before installation balances natural shade and pore movement.
TextSection.header4: Care and Protection
TextSection.text4: Use a pH-neutral natural-stone cleaner for routine care. Acids can etch travertine; an impregnator does not make stone stain-proof but may improve stain resistance when correctly selected.
TextSection.text5: Size, squareness, calibration, finish, filling and shade range are reviewed by production lot. Crate labels separate size and lot information to simplify stock and site distribution.

filled-natural.h1: Filled Natural Vein Cut Travertine Tiles
filled-natural.title: Filled Natural Vein Cut Travertine Tiles
filled-natural.lead: Linear vein movement, an filled pore structure and a natural finish in a modular tile format.
filled-natural.intro: Filled Natural Vein Cut Travertine Tiles combines linear vein movement with a more closed pore structure. The least altered option, retaining the texture left by cutting and the visible pore structure of the stone. Format, shade range and finish suitability are selected together for the project conditions.
filled-natural.title2: What Are Filled Natural Vein Cut Travertine Tiles?
filled-natural.intro2: Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering. The least altered option, retaining the texture left by cutting and the visible pore structure of the stone. Samples and technical performance data must be reviewed with the complete installation system for wet, exterior or heavy-use locations.

variants.title: Size and Colour Options
variants.text: This process can be planned in catalogue modules and Blaundos Ivory, Light and Antiko colours. Available combinations, shade range and production tolerances are confirmed before ordering.

description: The least altered option, retaining the texture left by cutting and the visible pore structure of the stone.

Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering.
Vein Cut production creates linear vein movement. Tile direction and pattern distribution can be reviewed through dry laying before installation.
Thickness, finish, filling, traffic and installation method should be selected together for the project; a finish name alone is not a performance guarantee for every location.

TextSection.text1: Filled Natural Vein Cut Travertine Tiles provide a modular natural-stone surface for interior floors, walls, bathrooms, lobbies and commercial spaces. Exterior and wet-area use should follow verification of stone test data and the complete installation system.
TextSection.text2: The least altered option, retaining the texture left by cutting and the visible pore structure of the stone. Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering.
TextSection.text3: Square, rectangular, large-format and Versailles modules are planned with the selected pattern direction. Blending from several crates before installation balances natural shade and pore movement.
TextSection.header4: Care and Protection
TextSection.text4: Use a pH-neutral natural-stone cleaner for routine care. Acids can etch travertine; an impregnator does not make stone stain-proof but may improve stain resistance when correctly selected.
TextSection.text5: Size, squareness, calibration, finish, filling and shade range are reviewed by production lot. Crate labels separate size and lot information to simplify stock and site distribution.

unfilled-natural.h1: Unfilled Natural Vein Cut Travertine Tiles
unfilled-natural.title: Unfilled Natural Vein Cut Travertine Tiles
unfilled-natural.lead: Linear vein movement, an unfilled pore structure and a natural finish in a modular tile format.
unfilled-natural.intro: Unfilled Natural Vein Cut Travertine Tiles combines linear vein movement with visible natural pores. The least altered option, retaining the texture left by cutting and the visible pore structure of the stone. Format, shade range and finish suitability are selected together for the project conditions.
unfilled-natural.title2: What Are Unfilled Natural Vein Cut Travertine Tiles?
unfilled-natural.intro2: Visible natural pores retain the characteristic voided structure of travertine. Whether voids remain open or are grouted during installation should be decided from the location and maintenance expectations. The least altered option, retaining the texture left by cutting and the visible pore structure of the stone. Samples and technical performance data must be reviewed with the complete installation system for wet, exterior or heavy-use locations.

variants.title: Size and Colour Options
variants.text: This process can be planned in catalogue modules and Blaundos Ivory, Light and Antiko colours. Available combinations, shade range and production tolerances are confirmed before ordering.

description: The least altered option, retaining the texture left by cutting and the visible pore structure of the stone.

Visible natural pores retain the characteristic voided structure of travertine. Whether voids remain open or are grouted during installation should be decided from the location and maintenance expectations.
Vein Cut production creates linear vein movement. Tile direction and pattern distribution can be reviewed through dry laying before installation.
Thickness, finish, filling, traffic and installation method should be selected together for the project; a finish name alone is not a performance guarantee for every location.

TextSection.text1: Unfilled Natural Vein Cut Travertine Tiles provide a modular natural-stone surface for interior floors, walls, bathrooms, lobbies and commercial spaces. Exterior and wet-area use should follow verification of stone test data and the complete installation system.
TextSection.text2: The least altered option, retaining the texture left by cutting and the visible pore structure of the stone. Visible natural pores retain the characteristic voided structure of travertine. Whether voids remain open or are grouted during installation should be decided from the location and maintenance expectations.
TextSection.text3: Square, rectangular, large-format and Versailles modules are planned with the selected pattern direction. Blending from several crates before installation balances natural shade and pore movement.
TextSection.header4: Care and Protection
TextSection.text4: Use a pH-neutral natural-stone cleaner for routine care. Acids can etch travertine; an impregnator does not make stone stain-proof but may improve stain resistance when correctly selected.
TextSection.text5: Size, squareness, calibration, finish, filling and shade range are reviewed by production lot. Crate labels separate size and lot information to simplify stock and site distribution.

seo.description: Pattern, filling, finish, size, application and care information for filled tumbled vein cut travertine tiles.

filled-tumbled.h1: Filled Tumbled Vein Cut Travertine Tiles
filled-tumbled.title: Filled Tumbled Vein Cut Travertine Tiles
filled-tumbled.lead: Linear vein movement, an filled pore structure and a tumbled finish in a modular tile format.
filled-tumbled.intro: Filled Tumbled Vein Cut Travertine Tiles combines linear vein movement with a more closed pore structure. Tumbling softens the edges and creates an irregular, time-worn character suited to more rustic compositions. Format, shade range and finish suitability are selected together for the project conditions.
filled-tumbled.title2: What Are Filled Tumbled Vein Cut Travertine Tiles?
filled-tumbled.intro2: Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering. Tumbling softens the edges and creates an irregular, time-worn character suited to more rustic compositions. Samples and technical performance data must be reviewed with the complete installation system for wet, exterior or heavy-use locations.

variants.title: Size and Colour Options
variants.text: This process can be planned in catalogue modules and Blaundos Ivory, Light and Antiko colours. Available combinations, shade range and production tolerances are confirmed before ordering.

description: Tumbling softens the edges and creates an irregular, time-worn character suited to more rustic compositions.

Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering.
Vein Cut production creates linear vein movement. Tile direction and pattern distribution can be reviewed through dry laying before installation.
Thickness, finish, filling, traffic and installation method should be selected together for the project; a finish name alone is not a performance guarantee for every location.

TextSection.text1: Filled Tumbled Vein Cut Travertine Tiles provide a modular natural-stone surface for interior floors, walls, bathrooms, lobbies and commercial spaces. Exterior and wet-area use should follow verification of stone test data and the complete installation system.
TextSection.text2: Tumbling softens the edges and creates an irregular, time-worn character suited to more rustic compositions. Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering.
TextSection.text3: Square, rectangular, large-format and Versailles modules are planned with the selected pattern direction. Blending from several crates before installation balances natural shade and pore movement.
TextSection.header4: Care and Protection
TextSection.text4: Use a pH-neutral natural-stone cleaner for routine care. Acids can etch travertine; an impregnator does not make stone stain-proof but may improve stain resistance when correctly selected.
TextSection.text5: Size, squareness, calibration, finish, filling and shade range are reviewed by production lot. Crate labels separate size and lot information to simplify stock and site distribution.

unfilled-tumbled.h1: Unfilled Tumbled Vein Cut Travertine Tiles
unfilled-tumbled.title: Unfilled Tumbled Vein Cut Travertine Tiles
unfilled-tumbled.lead: Linear vein movement, an unfilled pore structure and a tumbled finish in a modular tile format.
unfilled-tumbled.intro: Unfilled Tumbled Vein Cut Travertine Tiles combines linear vein movement with visible natural pores. Tumbling softens the edges and creates an irregular, time-worn character suited to more rustic compositions. Format, shade range and finish suitability are selected together for the project conditions.
unfilled-tumbled.title2: What Are Unfilled Tumbled Vein Cut Travertine Tiles?
unfilled-tumbled.intro2: Visible natural pores retain the characteristic voided structure of travertine. Whether voids remain open or are grouted during installation should be decided from the location and maintenance expectations. Tumbling softens the edges and creates an irregular, time-worn character suited to more rustic compositions. Samples and technical performance data must be reviewed with the complete installation system for wet, exterior or heavy-use locations.

variants.title: Size and Colour Options
variants.text: This process can be planned in catalogue modules and Blaundos Ivory, Light and Antiko colours. Available combinations, shade range and production tolerances are confirmed before ordering.

description: Tumbling softens the edges and creates an irregular, time-worn character suited to more rustic compositions.

Visible natural pores retain the characteristic voided structure of travertine. Whether voids remain open or are grouted during installation should be decided from the location and maintenance expectations.
Vein Cut production creates linear vein movement. Tile direction and pattern distribution can be reviewed through dry laying before installation.
Thickness, finish, filling, traffic and installation method should be selected together for the project; a finish name alone is not a performance guarantee for every location.

TextSection.text1: Unfilled Tumbled Vein Cut Travertine Tiles provide a modular natural-stone surface for interior floors, walls, bathrooms, lobbies and commercial spaces. Exterior and wet-area use should follow verification of stone test data and the complete installation system.
TextSection.text2: Tumbling softens the edges and creates an irregular, time-worn character suited to more rustic compositions. Visible natural pores retain the characteristic voided structure of travertine. Whether voids remain open or are grouted during installation should be decided from the location and maintenance expectations.
TextSection.text3: Square, rectangular, large-format and Versailles modules are planned with the selected pattern direction. Blending from several crates before installation balances natural shade and pore movement.
TextSection.header4: Care and Protection
TextSection.text4: Use a pH-neutral natural-stone cleaner for routine care. Acids can etch travertine; an impregnator does not make stone stain-proof but may improve stain resistance when correctly selected.
TextSection.text5: Size, squareness, calibration, finish, filling and shade range are reviewed by production lot. Crate labels separate size and lot information to simplify stock and site distribution.

seo.title: Cross Cut Travertine Tiles | Majen
seo.description: Pattern direction, finishes, modular sizes, application and care information for cross cut travertine tiles.

cross-cut.title: Cross Cut Travertine Tiles
cross-cut.intro: Cross-cut travertine tiles are sawn across the bedding, revealing dispersed cloud-like and circular patterning. Modular formats distribute natural tonal movement across the surface and create a layout that is less dependent on a single direction.
cross-cut.title2: How Is the Cross Cut Tile Pattern Created?
cross-cut.intro2: Because the cutting plane crosses the bedding, veins appear as soft islands and clouds rather than lines. Dry laying and blending from several crates help balance the natural pattern distribution.
cross-cut.desc: Modular travertine tiles with a cloud-like pattern distribution.

TextSection.text1: Cross-cut patterning is not tied to one dominant direction. Square and rectangular modules can be used in straight, staggered or Versailles layouts; blending from several crates balances the cloudy movement.
TextSection.text2: Filled tiles create a more closed surface that is easier to clean, while unfilled options retain visible natural voids. Honed, polished, brushed, tumbled and natural finishes produce different responses to light and touch.
TextSection.text3: Suitability is not determined by pattern alone. Stone test data and finish must be assessed with traffic, substrate flatness, adhesive, grout, waterproofing, drainage and movement-joint design.
TextSection.header4: Care
TextSection.text4: Use a neutral cleaner for calcium-carbonate based travertine and avoid acidic or abrasive products. Any impregnator should be selected with the finish, location and product-manufacturer guidance in mind.

description: Size, squareness, thickness calibration, edge accuracy and finish consistency are checked by production lot. Natural shade and pore variation are managed through the project blending plan rather than treated as defects.

Travertine tiles provide a modular natural-stone surface for interior floors, walls, bathrooms, lobbies and retail spaces. Exterior and wet-area use requires project-specific verification of performance and the complete installation system.

The catalogue includes 8×8, 12×12, 12×24, 16×16, 18×18, 24×24, 24×48 and 48×110 formats, plus the Versailles set. Available thickness and tolerances are confirmed for the intended application before ordering.

Natural, honed, polished, brushed and tumbled finishes create different visual and tactile results. Tiles are separated by size and lot and packed in export crates designed to protect faces and corners.

seo.description: Pattern, filling, finish, size, application and care information for unfilled honed cross cut travertine tiles.

unfilled-honed.h1: Unfilled Honed Cross Cut Travertine Tiles
unfilled-honed.title: Unfilled Honed Cross Cut Travertine Tiles
unfilled-honed.lead: Cloud-like pattern distribution, an unfilled pore structure and a honed finish in a modular tile format.
unfilled-honed.intro: Unfilled Honed Cross Cut Travertine Tiles combines cloud-like pattern distribution with visible natural pores. Honing creates a non-reflective, satin-matte appearance that presents the stone colour with restrained depth. Format, shade range and finish suitability are selected together for the project conditions.
unfilled-honed.title2: What Are Unfilled Honed Cross Cut Travertine Tiles?
unfilled-honed.intro2: Visible natural pores retain the characteristic voided structure of travertine. Whether voids remain open or are grouted during installation should be decided from the location and maintenance expectations. Honing creates a non-reflective, satin-matte appearance that presents the stone colour with restrained depth. Samples and technical performance data must be reviewed with the complete installation system for wet, exterior or heavy-use locations.

variants.title: Size and Colour Options
variants.text: This process can be planned in catalogue modules and Blaundos Ivory, Light and Antiko colours. Available combinations, shade range and production tolerances are confirmed before ordering.

description: Honing creates a non-reflective, satin-matte appearance that presents the stone colour with restrained depth.

Visible natural pores retain the characteristic voided structure of travertine. Whether voids remain open or are grouted during installation should be decided from the location and maintenance expectations.
Cross Cut production creates cloud-like pattern distribution. Tile direction and pattern distribution can be reviewed through dry laying before installation.
Thickness, finish, filling, traffic and installation method should be selected together for the project; a finish name alone is not a performance guarantee for every location.

TextSection.text1: Unfilled Honed Cross Cut Travertine Tiles provide a modular natural-stone surface for interior floors, walls, bathrooms, lobbies and commercial spaces. Exterior and wet-area use should follow verification of stone test data and the complete installation system.
TextSection.text2: Honing creates a non-reflective, satin-matte appearance that presents the stone colour with restrained depth. Visible natural pores retain the characteristic voided structure of travertine. Whether voids remain open or are grouted during installation should be decided from the location and maintenance expectations.
TextSection.text3: Square, rectangular, large-format and Versailles modules are planned with the selected pattern direction. Blending from several crates before installation balances natural shade and pore movement.
TextSection.header4: Care and Protection
TextSection.text4: Use a pH-neutral natural-stone cleaner for routine care. Acids can etch travertine; an impregnator does not make stone stain-proof but may improve stain resistance when correctly selected.
TextSection.text5: Size, squareness, calibration, finish, filling and shade range are reviewed by production lot. Crate labels separate size and lot information to simplify stock and site distribution.
