seo.description: Pattern, filling, finish, size, application and care information for filled honed cross cut travertine tiles.

filled-honed.h1: Filled Honed Cross Cut Travertine Tiles
filled-honed.title: Filled Honed Cross Cut Travertine Tiles
filled-honed.lead: Cloud-like pattern distribution, an filled pore structure and a honed finish in a modular tile format.
filled-honed.intro: Filled Honed Cross Cut Travertine Tiles combines cloud-like pattern distribution with a more closed pore structure. Honing creates a non-reflective, satin-matte appearance that presents the stone colour with restrained depth. Format, shade range and finish suitability are selected together for the project conditions.
filled-honed.title2: What Are Filled Honed Cross Cut Travertine Tiles?
filled-honed.intro2: Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering. Honing creates a non-reflective, satin-matte appearance that presents the stone colour with restrained depth. Samples and technical performance data must be reviewed with the complete installation system for wet, exterior or heavy-use locations.

variants.title: Size and Colour Options
variants.text: This process can be planned in catalogue modules and Blaundos Ivory, Light and Antiko colours. Available combinations, shade range and production tolerances are confirmed before ordering.

description: Honing creates a non-reflective, satin-matte appearance that presents the stone colour with restrained depth.

Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering.
Cross Cut production creates cloud-like pattern distribution. Tile direction and pattern distribution can be reviewed through dry laying before installation.
Thickness, finish, filling, traffic and installation method should be selected together for the project; a finish name alone is not a performance guarantee for every location.

TextSection.text1: Filled Honed Cross Cut Travertine Tiles provide a modular natural-stone surface for interior floors, walls, bathrooms, lobbies and commercial spaces. Exterior and wet-area use should follow verification of stone test data and the complete installation system.
TextSection.text2: Honing creates a non-reflective, satin-matte appearance that presents the stone colour with restrained depth. Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering.
TextSection.text3: Square, rectangular, large-format and Versailles modules are planned with the selected pattern direction. Blending from several crates before installation balances natural shade and pore movement.
TextSection.header4: Care and Protection
TextSection.text4: Use a pH-neutral natural-stone cleaner for routine care. Acids can etch travertine; an impregnator does not make stone stain-proof but may improve stain resistance when correctly selected.
TextSection.text5: Size, squareness, calibration, finish, filling and shade range are reviewed by production lot. Crate labels separate size and lot information to simplify stock and site distribution.

seo.title: Filled Polished Cross Cut Travertine Tiles | Majen
seo.description: Pattern, filling, finish, size, application and care information for filled polished cross cut travertine tiles.

filled-polished.h1: Filled Polished Cross Cut Travertine Tiles
filled-polished.title: Filled Polished Cross Cut Travertine Tiles
filled-polished.lead: Cloud-like pattern distribution, an filled pore structure and a polished finish in a modular tile format.
filled-polished.intro: Filled Polished Cross Cut Travertine Tiles combines cloud-like pattern distribution with a more closed pore structure. A glossy, highly reflective polished finish intensifies the colour and pattern contrast of travertine. Format, shade range and finish suitability are selected together for the project conditions.
filled-polished.title2: What Are Filled Polished Cross Cut Travertine Tiles?
filled-polished.intro2: Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering. A glossy, highly reflective polished finish intensifies the colour and pattern contrast of travertine. Samples and technical performance data must be reviewed with the complete installation system for wet, exterior or heavy-use locations.

variants.title: Size and Colour Options
variants.text: This process can be planned in catalogue modules and Blaundos Ivory, Light and Antiko colours. Available combinations, shade range and production tolerances are confirmed before ordering.

description: A glossy, highly reflective polished finish intensifies the colour and pattern contrast of travertine.

Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering.
Cross Cut production creates cloud-like pattern distribution. Tile direction and pattern distribution can be reviewed through dry laying before installation.
Thickness, finish, filling, traffic and installation method should be selected together for the project; a finish name alone is not a performance guarantee for every location.

TextSection.text1: Filled Polished Cross Cut Travertine Tiles provide a modular natural-stone surface for interior floors, walls, bathrooms, lobbies and commercial spaces. Exterior and wet-area use should follow verification of stone test data and the complete installation system.
TextSection.text2: A glossy, highly reflective polished finish intensifies the colour and pattern contrast of travertine. Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering.
TextSection.text3: Square, rectangular, large-format and Versailles modules are planned with the selected pattern direction. Blending from several crates before installation balances natural shade and pore movement.
TextSection.header4: Care and Protection
TextSection.text4: Use a pH-neutral natural-stone cleaner for routine care. Acids can etch travertine; an impregnator does not make stone stain-proof but may improve stain resistance when correctly selected.
TextSection.text5: Size, squareness, calibration, finish, filling and shade range are reviewed by production lot. Crate labels separate size and lot information to simplify stock and site distribution.

QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq_span1: Filled Polished Cross Cut Travertine Tiles
QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq1_header: What does a polished finish look like?
QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq1_text: A glossy, highly reflective polished finish intensifies the colour and pattern contrast of travertine.
QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq2_text: Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering.
QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq3_header: Can it be used in wet or exterior areas?
QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq3_text: Suitability must be assessed from samples and technical data together with substrate, waterproofing, drainage, adhesive, grout and movement-joint design.
QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq4_header: Which sizes are available?
QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq4_text: Catalogue modules and the Versailles set are offered. Exact thickness and tolerances are confirmed against the intended use before ordering.
QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq5_text: Use a pH-neutral natural-stone cleaner and avoid vinegar, lemon and other acidic or abrasive products.
QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq6_header: How should natural shade variation be managed?
QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq6_text: Dry lay and blend tiles from several crates before installation to distribute shade and pattern transitions across the surface.

unfilled-polished.h1: Unfilled Polished Cross Cut Travertine Tiles
unfilled-polished.title: Unfilled Polished Cross Cut Travertine Tiles
unfilled-polished.lead: Cloud-like pattern distribution, an unfilled pore structure and a polished finish in a modular tile format.
unfilled-polished.intro: Unfilled Polished Cross Cut Travertine Tiles combines cloud-like pattern distribution with visible natural pores. A glossy, highly reflective polished finish intensifies the colour and pattern contrast of travertine. Format, shade range and finish suitability are selected together for the project conditions.
unfilled-polished.title2: What Are Unfilled Polished Cross Cut Travertine Tiles?
unfilled-polished.intro2: Visible natural pores retain the characteristic voided structure of travertine. Whether voids remain open or are grouted during installation should be decided from the location and maintenance expectations. A glossy, highly reflective polished finish intensifies the colour and pattern contrast of travertine. Samples and technical performance data must be reviewed with the complete installation system for wet, exterior or heavy-use locations.

variants.title: Size and Colour Options
variants.text: This process can be planned in catalogue modules and Blaundos Ivory, Light and Antiko colours. Available combinations, shade range and production tolerances are confirmed before ordering.

description: A glossy, highly reflective polished finish intensifies the colour and pattern contrast of travertine.

Visible natural pores retain the characteristic voided structure of travertine. Whether voids remain open or are grouted during installation should be decided from the location and maintenance expectations.
Cross Cut production creates cloud-like pattern distribution. Tile direction and pattern distribution can be reviewed through dry laying before installation.
Thickness, finish, filling, traffic and installation method should be selected together for the project; a finish name alone is not a performance guarantee for every location.

TextSection.text1: Unfilled Polished Cross Cut Travertine Tiles provide a modular natural-stone surface for interior floors, walls, bathrooms, lobbies and commercial spaces. Exterior and wet-area use should follow verification of stone test data and the complete installation system.
TextSection.text2: A glossy, highly reflective polished finish intensifies the colour and pattern contrast of travertine. Visible natural pores retain the characteristic voided structure of travertine. Whether voids remain open or are grouted during installation should be decided from the location and maintenance expectations.
TextSection.text3: Square, rectangular, large-format and Versailles modules are planned with the selected pattern direction. Blending from several crates before installation balances natural shade and pore movement.
TextSection.header4: Care and Protection
TextSection.text4: Use a pH-neutral natural-stone cleaner for routine care. Acids can etch travertine; an impregnator does not make stone stain-proof but may improve stain resistance when correctly selected.
TextSection.text5: Size, squareness, calibration, finish, filling and shade range are reviewed by production lot. Crate labels separate size and lot information to simplify stock and site distribution.

filled-brushed.h1: Filled Brushed Cross Cut Travertine Tiles
filled-brushed.title: Filled Brushed Cross Cut Travertine Tiles
filled-brushed.lead: Cloud-like pattern distribution, an filled pore structure and a brushed finish in a modular tile format.
filled-brushed.intro: Filled Brushed Cross Cut Travertine Tiles combines cloud-like pattern distribution with a more closed pore structure. Abrasive brushing gives the surface light relief and a more tactile texture. Format, shade range and finish suitability are selected together for the project conditions.
filled-brushed.title2: What Are Filled Brushed Cross Cut Travertine Tiles?
filled-brushed.intro2: Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering. Abrasive brushing gives the surface light relief and a more tactile texture. Samples and technical performance data must be reviewed with the complete installation system for wet, exterior or heavy-use locations.

variants.title: Size and Colour Options
variants.text: This process can be planned in catalogue modules and Blaundos Ivory, Light and Antiko colours. Available combinations, shade range and production tolerances are confirmed before ordering.

description: Abrasive brushing gives the surface light relief and a more tactile texture.

Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering.
Cross Cut production creates cloud-like pattern distribution. Tile direction and pattern distribution can be reviewed through dry laying before installation.
Thickness, finish, filling, traffic and installation method should be selected together for the project; a finish name alone is not a performance guarantee for every location.

TextSection.text1: Filled Brushed Cross Cut Travertine Tiles provide a modular natural-stone surface for interior floors, walls, bathrooms, lobbies and commercial spaces. Exterior and wet-area use should follow verification of stone test data and the complete installation system.
TextSection.text2: Abrasive brushing gives the surface light relief and a more tactile texture. Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering.
TextSection.text3: Square, rectangular, large-format and Versailles modules are planned with the selected pattern direction. Blending from several crates before installation balances natural shade and pore movement.
TextSection.header4: Care and Protection
TextSection.text4: Use a pH-neutral natural-stone cleaner for routine care. Acids can etch travertine; an impregnator does not make stone stain-proof but may improve stain resistance when correctly selected.
TextSection.text5: Size, squareness, calibration, finish, filling and shade range are reviewed by production lot. Crate labels separate size and lot information to simplify stock and site distribution.

filled-natural.h1: Filled Natural Cross Cut Travertine Tiles
filled-natural.title: Filled Natural Cross Cut Travertine Tiles
filled-natural.lead: Cloud-like pattern distribution, an filled pore structure and a natural finish in a modular tile format.
filled-natural.intro: Filled Natural Cross Cut Travertine Tiles combines cloud-like pattern distribution with a more closed pore structure. The least altered option, retaining the texture left by cutting and the visible pore structure of the stone. Format, shade range and finish suitability are selected together for the project conditions.
filled-natural.title2: What Are Filled Natural Cross Cut Travertine Tiles?
filled-natural.intro2: Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering. The least altered option, retaining the texture left by cutting and the visible pore structure of the stone. Samples and technical performance data must be reviewed with the complete installation system for wet, exterior or heavy-use locations.

variants.title: Size and Colour Options
variants.text: This process can be planned in catalogue modules and Blaundos Ivory, Light and Antiko colours. Available combinations, shade range and production tolerances are confirmed before ordering.

description: The least altered option, retaining the texture left by cutting and the visible pore structure of the stone.

Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering.
Cross Cut production creates cloud-like pattern distribution. Tile direction and pattern distribution can be reviewed through dry laying before installation.
Thickness, finish, filling, traffic and installation method should be selected together for the project; a finish name alone is not a performance guarantee for every location.

TextSection.text1: Filled Natural Cross Cut Travertine Tiles provide a modular natural-stone surface for interior floors, walls, bathrooms, lobbies and commercial spaces. Exterior and wet-area use should follow verification of stone test data and the complete installation system.
TextSection.text2: The least altered option, retaining the texture left by cutting and the visible pore structure of the stone. Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering.
TextSection.text3: Square, rectangular, large-format and Versailles modules are planned with the selected pattern direction. Blending from several crates before installation balances natural shade and pore movement.
TextSection.header4: Care and Protection
TextSection.text4: Use a pH-neutral natural-stone cleaner for routine care. Acids can etch travertine; an impregnator does not make stone stain-proof but may improve stain resistance when correctly selected.
TextSection.text5: Size, squareness, calibration, finish, filling and shade range are reviewed by production lot. Crate labels separate size and lot information to simplify stock and site distribution.

seo.description: Pattern, filling, finish, size, application and care information for unfilled natural cross cut travertine tiles.

unfilled-natural.h1: Unfilled Natural Cross Cut Travertine Tiles
unfilled-natural.title: Unfilled Natural Cross Cut Travertine Tiles
unfilled-natural.lead: Cloud-like pattern distribution, an unfilled pore structure and a natural finish in a modular tile format.
unfilled-natural.intro: Unfilled Natural Cross Cut Travertine Tiles combines cloud-like pattern distribution with visible natural pores. The least altered option, retaining the texture left by cutting and the visible pore structure of the stone. Format, shade range and finish suitability are selected together for the project conditions.
unfilled-natural.title2: What Are Unfilled Natural Cross Cut Travertine Tiles?
unfilled-natural.intro2: Visible natural pores retain the characteristic voided structure of travertine. Whether voids remain open or are grouted during installation should be decided from the location and maintenance expectations. The least altered option, retaining the texture left by cutting and the visible pore structure of the stone. Samples and technical performance data must be reviewed with the complete installation system for wet, exterior or heavy-use locations.

variants.title: Size and Colour Options
variants.text: This process can be planned in catalogue modules and Blaundos Ivory, Light and Antiko colours. Available combinations, shade range and production tolerances are confirmed before ordering.

description: The least altered option, retaining the texture left by cutting and the visible pore structure of the stone.

Visible natural pores retain the characteristic voided structure of travertine. Whether voids remain open or are grouted during installation should be decided from the location and maintenance expectations.
Cross Cut production creates cloud-like pattern distribution. Tile direction and pattern distribution can be reviewed through dry laying before installation.
Thickness, finish, filling, traffic and installation method should be selected together for the project; a finish name alone is not a performance guarantee for every location.

TextSection.text1: Unfilled Natural Cross Cut Travertine Tiles provide a modular natural-stone surface for interior floors, walls, bathrooms, lobbies and commercial spaces. Exterior and wet-area use should follow verification of stone test data and the complete installation system.
TextSection.text2: The least altered option, retaining the texture left by cutting and the visible pore structure of the stone. Visible natural pores retain the characteristic voided structure of travertine. Whether voids remain open or are grouted during installation should be decided from the location and maintenance expectations.
TextSection.text3: Square, rectangular, large-format and Versailles modules are planned with the selected pattern direction. Blending from several crates before installation balances natural shade and pore movement.
TextSection.header4: Care and Protection
TextSection.text4: Use a pH-neutral natural-stone cleaner for routine care. Acids can etch travertine; an impregnator does not make stone stain-proof but may improve stain resistance when correctly selected.
TextSection.text5: Size, squareness, calibration, finish, filling and shade range are reviewed by production lot. Crate labels separate size and lot information to simplify stock and site distribution.

seo.title: Unfilled Brushed Cross Cut Travertine Tiles | Majen
seo.description: Pattern, filling, finish, size, application and care information for unfilled brushed cross cut travertine tiles.

unfilled-brushed.h1: Unfilled Brushed Cross Cut Travertine Tiles
unfilled-brushed.title: Unfilled Brushed Cross Cut Travertine Tiles
unfilled-brushed.lead: Cloud-like pattern distribution, an unfilled pore structure and a brushed finish in a modular tile format.
unfilled-brushed.intro: Unfilled Brushed Cross Cut Travertine Tiles combines cloud-like pattern distribution with visible natural pores. Abrasive brushing gives the surface light relief and a more tactile texture. Format, shade range and finish suitability are selected together for the project conditions.
unfilled-brushed.title2: What Are Unfilled Brushed Cross Cut Travertine Tiles?
unfilled-brushed.intro2: Visible natural pores retain the characteristic voided structure of travertine. Whether voids remain open or are grouted during installation should be decided from the location and maintenance expectations. Abrasive brushing gives the surface light relief and a more tactile texture. Samples and technical performance data must be reviewed with the complete installation system for wet, exterior or heavy-use locations.

variants.title: Size and Colour Options
variants.text: This process can be planned in catalogue modules and Blaundos Ivory, Light and Antiko colours. Available combinations, shade range and production tolerances are confirmed before ordering.

description: Abrasive brushing gives the surface light relief and a more tactile texture.

Visible natural pores retain the characteristic voided structure of travertine. Whether voids remain open or are grouted during installation should be decided from the location and maintenance expectations.
Cross Cut production creates cloud-like pattern distribution. Tile direction and pattern distribution can be reviewed through dry laying before installation.
Thickness, finish, filling, traffic and installation method should be selected together for the project; a finish name alone is not a performance guarantee for every location.

TextSection.text1: Unfilled Brushed Cross Cut Travertine Tiles provide a modular natural-stone surface for interior floors, walls, bathrooms, lobbies and commercial spaces. Exterior and wet-area use should follow verification of stone test data and the complete installation system.
TextSection.text2: Abrasive brushing gives the surface light relief and a more tactile texture. Visible natural pores retain the characteristic voided structure of travertine. Whether voids remain open or are grouted during installation should be decided from the location and maintenance expectations.
TextSection.text3: Square, rectangular, large-format and Versailles modules are planned with the selected pattern direction. Blending from several crates before installation balances natural shade and pore movement.
TextSection.header4: Care and Protection
TextSection.text4: Use a pH-neutral natural-stone cleaner for routine care. Acids can etch travertine; an impregnator does not make stone stain-proof but may improve stain resistance when correctly selected.
TextSection.text5: Size, squareness, calibration, finish, filling and shade range are reviewed by production lot. Crate labels separate size and lot information to simplify stock and site distribution.

filled-tumbled.h1: Filled Tumbled Cross Cut Travertine Tiles
filled-tumbled.title: Filled Tumbled Cross Cut Travertine Tiles
filled-tumbled.lead: Cloud-like pattern distribution, an filled pore structure and a tumbled finish in a modular tile format.
filled-tumbled.intro: Filled Tumbled Cross Cut Travertine Tiles combines cloud-like pattern distribution with a more closed pore structure. Tumbling softens the edges and creates an irregular, time-worn character suited to more rustic compositions. Format, shade range and finish suitability are selected together for the project conditions.
filled-tumbled.title2: What Are Filled Tumbled Cross Cut Travertine Tiles?
filled-tumbled.intro2: Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering. Tumbling softens the edges and creates an irregular, time-worn character suited to more rustic compositions. Samples and technical performance data must be reviewed with the complete installation system for wet, exterior or heavy-use locations.

variants.title: Size and Colour Options
variants.text: This process can be planned in catalogue modules and Blaundos Ivory, Light and Antiko colours. Available combinations, shade range and production tolerances are confirmed before ordering.

description: Tumbling softens the edges and creates an irregular, time-worn character suited to more rustic compositions.

Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering.
Cross Cut production creates cloud-like pattern distribution. Tile direction and pattern distribution can be reviewed through dry laying before installation.
Thickness, finish, filling, traffic and installation method should be selected together for the project; a finish name alone is not a performance guarantee for every location.

TextSection.text1: Filled Tumbled Cross Cut Travertine Tiles provide a modular natural-stone surface for interior floors, walls, bathrooms, lobbies and commercial spaces. Exterior and wet-area use should follow verification of stone test data and the complete installation system.
TextSection.text2: Tumbling softens the edges and creates an irregular, time-worn character suited to more rustic compositions. Pores closed with a compatible filling material during production create a more continuous surface that is easier to clean. Fill colour, stone shade and service conditions should be reviewed together before ordering.
TextSection.text3: Square, rectangular, large-format and Versailles modules are planned with the selected pattern direction. Blending from several crates before installation balances natural shade and pore movement.
TextSection.header4: Care and Protection
TextSection.text4: Use a pH-neutral natural-stone cleaner for routine care. Acids can etch travertine; an impregnator does not make stone stain-proof but may improve stain resistance when correctly selected.
TextSection.text5: Size, squareness, calibration, finish, filling and shade range are reviewed by production lot. Crate labels separate size and lot information to simplify stock and site distribution.

unfilled-tumbled.h1: Unfilled Tumbled Cross Cut Travertine Tiles
unfilled-tumbled.title: Unfilled Tumbled Cross Cut Travertine Tiles
unfilled-tumbled.lead: Cloud-like pattern distribution, an unfilled pore structure and a tumbled finish in a modular tile format.
unfilled-tumbled.intro: Unfilled Tumbled Cross Cut Travertine Tiles combines cloud-like pattern distribution with visible natural pores. Tumbling softens the edges and creates an irregular, time-worn character suited to more rustic compositions. Format, shade range and finish suitability are selected together for the project conditions.
unfilled-tumbled.title2: What Are Unfilled Tumbled Cross Cut Travertine Tiles?
unfilled-tumbled.intro2: Visible natural pores retain the characteristic voided structure of travertine. Whether voids remain open or are grouted during installation should be decided from the location and maintenance expectations. Tumbling softens the edges and creates an irregular, time-worn character suited to more rustic compositions. Samples and technical performance data must be reviewed with the complete installation system for wet, exterior or heavy-use locations.

variants.title: Size and Colour Options
variants.text: This process can be planned in catalogue modules and Blaundos Ivory, Light and Antiko colours. Available combinations, shade range and production tolerances are confirmed before ordering.

description: Tumbling softens the edges and creates an irregular, time-worn character suited to more rustic compositions.

Visible natural pores retain the characteristic voided structure of travertine. Whether voids remain open or are grouted during installation should be decided from the location and maintenance expectations.
Cross Cut production creates cloud-like pattern distribution. Tile direction and pattern distribution can be reviewed through dry laying before installation.
Thickness, finish, filling, traffic and installation method should be selected together for the project; a finish name alone is not a performance guarantee for every location.

TextSection.text1: Unfilled Tumbled Cross Cut Travertine Tiles provide a modular natural-stone surface for interior floors, walls, bathrooms, lobbies and commercial spaces. Exterior and wet-area use should follow verification of stone test data and the complete installation system.
TextSection.text2: Tumbling softens the edges and creates an irregular, time-worn character suited to more rustic compositions. Visible natural pores retain the characteristic voided structure of travertine. Whether voids remain open or are grouted during installation should be decided from the location and maintenance expectations.
TextSection.text3: Square, rectangular, large-format and Versailles modules are planned with the selected pattern direction. Blending from several crates before installation balances natural shade and pore movement.
TextSection.header4: Care and Protection
TextSection.text4: Use a pH-neutral natural-stone cleaner for routine care. Acids can etch travertine; an impregnator does not make stone stain-proof but may improve stain resistance when correctly selected.
TextSection.text5: Size, squareness, calibration, finish, filling and shade range are reviewed by production lot. Crate labels separate size and lot information to simplify stock and site distribution.

pavers.title: Wholesale Travertine Pavers
pavers.name: pavers
pavers.intro: Turkish travertine pavers are a timeless choice for outdoor surfaces, offering durability, elegance, and a natural non-slip texture. As a supplier of natural stone from Turkey, Majen delivers premium-quality pavers sourced from Uşak–Ulubey. Designed for pool decks, patios, and walkways, our travertine ensures lasting performance and aesthetic appeal in every climate.
pavers.title2: Why Choose Travertine Pavers for Your Outdoor Projects?
pavers.intro2: Travertine’s natural cooling effect, high slip resistance, and rich color palette make it the preferred material for outdoor applications. Its porous texture keeps surfaces cool underfoot, even in warm climates. Compared to concrete or porcelain, travertine pavers maintain color depth and texture over time, ensuring both functionality and visual luxury for high-end landscape designs.
description: Travertine pavers withstand heavy foot traffic and extreme weather. Their dense structure resists cracks, ensuring long-lasting performance for outdoor spaces worldwide.
The naturally textured surface of travertine provides excellent slip resistance, making it ideal for pool decks, patios, and other wet environments.
Available in warm beiges, cool silvers, and golden tones, travertine pavers create elegant outdoor aesthetics that match any design concept.
With minimal upkeep, travertine pavers retain their natural beauty. Regular sealing enhances protection while preserving their luxurious finish.

variants.heading: Travertine Pavers Varieties
variants.text: Majen offers three primary Turkish travertine paver varieties: Blaundos Antiko, Blaundos Light, and Blaundos Ivory. Each variety is crafted with precision at our Uşak–Ulubey quarry, ensuring durability, consistent texture, and aesthetic value. Export-ready and reinforced for sea freight, these bespoke travertine pavers are trusted by architects, importers, and wholesalers worldwide.

TextSection.text1: Paver thickness and format should respond to the substrate and expected load, not appearance alone. Smaller modules follow slopes efficiently on walkways, while large formats create calmer terraces. Vehicle approaches require a heavier section and an installation bed designed for the anticipated traffic.
TextSection.header2: Grip, Edge Strength and Freeze Conditions
TextSection.text2: Outdoor inspection considers texture, edge stability, thickness and pore structure together. Pool surrounds require a balance between wet grip and barefoot comfort. In cold climates, drainage, suitable joints and the complete installation system are part of selecting the right paver.
TextSection.text3: Running bond, staggered layouts and Versailles Pattern can adapt to different site geometries. Format combinations should be planned with cutting loss, joint width and drainage fall in mind. A suitable module reduces unnecessary small cuts around pools and terrace boundaries.
TextSection.header4: Packing by Installation Sequence
TextSection.text4: On mixed-format projects, every module is counted, labelled and listed separately. Edges are protected against impact, and crates can be organized by installation zone or pattern set. Site teams can then move the correct stone to the correct area with less sorting.
TextSection.subtext1: Thickness is selected around pedestrian, landscape or vehicle loads and the intended bedding system.
TextSection.subtext2: Texture selection balances wet grip, barefoot comfort and surface feel under direct sun.
TextSection.subtext3: A multi-format set adds natural rhythm and distributes travertine shade variation across wide areas.
TextSection.subtext4: Correct falls, joint width and water evacuation are as important as the stone itself for long-term outdoor performance.

QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq_span1: From Turkey
QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq1_header: What are travertine pavers best used for?
QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq1_text: Travertine pavers are ideal for pool decks, patios, garden paths, and driveways due to their natural slip resistance and thermal comfort.
QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq2_header: Do you export travertine pavers worldwide?
QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq2_text: Yes, Majen exports globally, with clients in North America, Europe, and the Middle East. We handle all shipping and customs documentation.
QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq3_header: What sizes and thickness options are available?
QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq3_text: We offer pavers in 6x12”, 8x16”, and 12x24” sizes, with 3–5 cm thickness. Custom dimensions are available for bulk orders.
QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq4_header: How do travertine pavers compare to concrete or porcelain?
QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq4_text: Travertine offers superior aesthetics, natural cooling, and longevity compared to artificial alternatives like concrete or porcelain.
QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq5_header: Are travertine pavers suitable for cold climates?
QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq5_text: Yes, properly sealed travertine performs well even in freeze-thaw conditions, maintaining durability and appearance.
QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq6_header: Can I order custom finishes or edge profiles?
QuestionsItems.aboutpage_s4_faq6_text: YAbsolutely. We provide brushed, tumbled, and honed finishes, along with custom edge profiles to fit your project needs.

cuts.heading: Travertine Pavers Cut Options
cuts.text: Choose honed for subtle refinement, brushed or tumbled for traction and texture, and polished for high-end interiors.
description: High durability, quarry-direct sourcing from Uşak–Ulubey, and precise cutting deliver consistent A-grade travertine slabs. Reliable lead times and reinforced packing make Majen a trusted partner for global projects.

Travertine slabs are used for countertops, wall cladding, interior floors and exterior facades in residential, hospitality and commercial developments. Blaundos Antiko, Light and Ivory offer distinct tones for different design intents.
Standard production in 2 cm, 3 cm and 5 cm thickness. Common sizes include large formats suitable for efficient fabrication, reducing waste and ensuring predictable results at scale.
Available finishes: polished, honed, brushed, tumbled. Slabs are packed in reinforced wooden crates, strapped and wrapped for safe container loading and long-distance sea freight.

seo.title: Vein Cut Travertine Pavers | Global Exporter of Premium Outdoor Stone

vein-cut.desc: Vein Cut Travertine Pavers reveal the natural linear veins of the stone, creating a striking, continuous flow across surfaces. Ideal for wall cladding, flooring, and large-format designs that emphasize movement and depth.

cards.text1: From luxury hospitality to private villas, Blaundos Antico adapts to varied aesthetics. Its neutral warmth pairs well with wood, metal, and glass, allowing cohesive palettes in mixed-material schemes. Designers value its ability to soften minimal interiors or enrich traditional settings with organic texture. Available finishes expand possibilities, from refined polished looks to tactile brushed or tumbled surfaces ideal for outdoor paths and pool surrounds. The result is a reliable, elegant stone that elevates spaces without visual noise.
cards.text2: Calibrated thickness, consistent flatness, and suitable surface treatments help Blaundos Antico perform in lobbies, corridors, and retail zones. Anti-slip options support safety outdoors, while proper sealing enhances stain resistance indoors. With accurate cutting and tight tolerances, installers achieve clean joints and level surfaces, reducing rework and time on site. This blend of aesthetics and practicality positions Blaundos Antico as a proven specification for demanding, design-driven environments across climates and usage patterns.

ApplicationSection.title: Applications of Blaundos Antico Travertine Slabs
ApplicationSection.text: Blaundos Antico is specified for floors, wall cladding, countertops, fireplace surrounds, stair treads, and exterior facades. Its antique texture lends character to boutique hotels and residences, while honed or polished finishes suit refined interiors. Outdoors, brushed or tumbled slabs complement landscaping, garden paths, and pool decks. The stone’s tonal stability supports continuity between inside and outside, helping designers create cohesive transitions. With accurate sizing and reliable supply, it scales from small renovations to flagship builds.
ApplicationSection.subtitle: Interior & Exterior Use Cases
ApplicationSection.subtext: Indoors, Blaundos Antico brings warmth to living areas and statement value to feature walls or reception desks. In kitchens and baths, sealed surfaces provide practical durability with natural beauty. Externally, its weathered look enriches patios and facades, aging gracefully over time. For public spaces, coordinated formats (slabs, tiles, custom pieces) keep design language consistent. Majen’s technical support advises on finish selection, slip ratings, and maintenance to match climate, footfall, and performance requirements.

AvailableSection.title: Available Sizes & Thickness
AvailableSection.text: Majen supplies slabs commonly at 2 cm and 3 cm thickness, cut from blocks selected for tone and structure. Custom dimensions can be produced on request, including book-matched sets for feature walls. Tight calibration and precision polishing ensure flatness and clean edges that speed installation. For special elements—vanities, stair treads or oversized cladding—our team provides cut-to-size options that maintain vein continuity. Consistent sizing across batches supports predictable waste rates and accurate take-offs.
AvailableSection.subtitle: Dimensional Tolerances
AvailableSection.subtext: Slab thickness is controlled within industry tolerances to support even load distribution and dependable adhesion. Surface regularity reduces lippage risk on large floors, while square edges and stable geometry help installers achieve fine joints in visual-critical areas. For ventilated facades and lightweight assemblies, we coordinate with fabricators to meet bracket and anchor constraints. All dimensions are verified at dispatch, and reports are available for documentation and submittal packages when required.

FinishesSection.title: Finishes & Packaging Options
FinishesSection.text: Blaundos Antico can be supplied polished, honed, brushed or tumbled to align with design intent and slip resistance needs. Finishes are applied with calibrated equipment to keep tone and sheen consistent across lots. For export, slabs are packed in reinforced wooden bundles with corner guards, interleaves, and strapping that limits movement in transit. Moisture-resistant wrapping and clear labeling aid handling at ports and job sites. Packaging is optimized for container loading to minimize risk and freight costs.
FinishesSection.subtitle: Surface Finish Guidance
FinishesSection.subtext: Select polished for premium interiors, honed for low-glare sophistication, brushed where texture is desired, and tumbled for rustic, outdoor-ready charm. In wet areas or exterior paths, combine texture with appropriate sealers to improve maintenance and slip performance. We can supply matched samples across finishes so teams preview appearance under project lighting. This process helps align expectations early, reducing change orders and helping stakeholders approve materials quickly and confidently.
FinishesSection.subtext2: Each bundle is photographed and measured prior to loading. Straps, braces, and internal blocking limit vibration, while protective interlayers reduce abrasion. Bundle IDs map to packing lists for fast checks at customs and on site. Shock indicators can be added on request. The goal is simple: slabs arrive installation-ready, with documentation that keeps receiving and quality verification efficient for importers and contractors.

PartnerSection.title: Why Partner with Majen for Travertine Slabs?
PartnerSection.description: Beyond quarry access, Majen offers technical guidance, flexible MOQs, and dependable lead times that fit real-world schedules. Direct sourcing keeps costs predictable and ensures tone matching across lots. Reinforced packaging, thorough documentation, and responsive support reduce friction during shipping and receiving. We build long-term relationships with importers, distributors, and contractors, providing post-delivery assistance and repeatable quality so projects finish on brief, on schedule, and on time.
PartnerSection.text1: From sampling and mock-ups to installation advice, our team responds quickly with practical guidance. Multilingual communication, transparent timelines, and after-sales follow-up help keep stakeholders aligned. Whether you need book-matched features, custom cuts or coordinated tiles, we manage details and share progress so decisions stay informed.
PartnerSection.text2: We prioritize responsible quarrying, water recycling, and waste reduction. Material traceability and documentation support green building goals and client ESG policies. These practices contribute to durable, long-life installations with lower lifecycle impact.
PartnerSection.text3: We provide packing data, certificates of origin, and HS codes; optional lab tests and slip ratings can be arranged. This documentation simplifies import processes and supports submittals for architects and contractors, helping approvals proceed without delays.

TextSection.text1: Explore complementary selections that pair well with Blaundos Antico. Each variety offers distinct tone and movement for different design intents, enabling cohesive palettes across floors, walls, and facades. Discover Blaundos Light Slabs for brighter schemes and Blaundos Ivory Slabs for creamy warmth. Coordinate with Travertine Tiles or Travertine Blocks to extend the language of natural stone through interiors, exteriors, and custom elements while keeping sourcing streamlined under one partner.
TextSection.text2: Ideal for kitchen islands, vanities and lobby walls. Pair with vein-cut bookmatch for dramatic continuity; specify 20–30 mm for interiors, 30+ mm for high-stress zones.
TextSection.text3: Reinforced A-frames, corner and moisture protection, photo-documented loading and shared seal numbers. FOB İzmir or CIF to major ports.

cards.text1: From luxury hospitality to private villas, Blaundos Antico adapts to varied aesthetics. BlaundosIntro.title: In the Footsteps of Blaundos
BlaundosIntro.paragraph: Chiaro ® by MAJEN is a refined light natural stone quarried in Ulubey, Uşak, near the ancient city of Blaundos, a Hellenistic settlement founded after Alexander the Great's Anatolian campaign and set atop a dramatic landscape of deep valleys. Defined by its clean white background, soft tonal transitions, and subtle organic movement, Chiaro brings clarity, brightness, and understated elegance to both residential and commercial spaces. Its timeless aesthetic adapts effortlessly to modern, minimal, and classic architectural styles, making it ideal for floors, walls, bathrooms, kitchens, and large-scale design applications. Responsibly sourced from MAJEN's quarry and produced with consistent quality standards, Chiaro delivers the natural beauty of stone with the reliability demanded by today's architectural projects.

travertine-tiles.intro: Travertine tiles are one of the most popular natural stone products, chosen for their elegance, durability, and timeless appeal. Used across floors, walls, bathrooms, kitchens, and outdoor spaces, Turkish travertine tiles combine centuries of architectural heritage with modern design versatility. Their wide range of colors, finishes, and sizes allow designers, contractors, and homeowners to adapt them to almost any style, from contemporary minimalism to classic Mediterranean charm.

lead.rest: This guide covers colors, finishes, standard sizes, specs and best-use cases so architects, distributors and contractors can specify wholesale travertine tiles with confidence. colors.intro: Color is one of the most important factors when selecting travertine tiles, as it defines the overall atmosphere of a space. Ivory, Light, and Antico travertine tiles are the most sought-after variations, each offering unique tones and patterns. Ivory creates bright, clean environments perfect for luxury interiors. Light offers warm beige tones that blend seamlessly in both modern and traditional designs. Antico, with its rustic hues, is ideal for Mediterranean or antique-inspired spaces. These natural variations ensure no two tiles are identical, adding authenticity and depth to every project.

details.p: Select thickness (10–12 mm) for interiors and seal after installation. Large formats (e. g., 60×60 or 60×120) speed up installation and minimize grout lines. For commercial lobbies, consider honed/brushed finishes for comfort and safety.

specs.intro: Travertine tiles are manufactured in standard sizes and thicknesses that meet international guidelines for construction and interior design. Indoor tiles typically range from 10–12 mm thick, while outdoor pavers reach 30 mm or more for added strength. Water absorption is usually 0.4–0.8%, highlighting the importance of sealing. Common sizes include 300×300 mm, 400×400 mm, and 600×600 mm, though cut-to-size formats are widely available for custom projects. These properties ensure that travertine tiles perform reliably in both high-traffic interiors and exposed outdoor environments.

install.intro: Proper installation is key to the performance and longevity of travertine tiles. Installers should apply cement-based adhesive to stable substrates and back-butter large tiles to ensure bonding. Joints should allow for movement, and grouting should be chosen based on flexibility. After curing, sealing is essential to protect tiles from stains and moisture. Routine cleaning with pH-neutral solutions maintains their natural look, while resealing every 1–2 years ensures durability. Avoid acidic cleaners, as they can damage the stone surface.

Allow movement joints; choose flexible grout for high-traffic zones.

faq.intro: These frequently asked questions address the most common topics about travertine tiles, including installation, sealing, and suitability for different environments.

items.q: Are travertine tiles good for flooring?
items.a: Yes. Travertine tiles are widely used for flooring because they combine strength, beauty, and durability. They handle daily foot traffic well and maintain a timeless aesthetic. When sealed and cared for properly, they can last for decades in both residential and commercial environments.

items.q: Which finishes are best for bathrooms?
items.a: Honed and tumbled finishes are the most recommended for bathrooms, as they offer slip comfort and a natural feel. Polished finishes may look luxurious but can be slippery when wet, so they are best reserved for vanity tops or decorative walls.

Yes. Like most natural stones, travertine tiles are porous and require sealing to prevent stains and moisture absorption. It is essential to seal upon installation and reapply every 12–24 months, depending on traffic and exposure. This simple maintenance step significantly extends their lifespan.

items.q: Can travertine tiles be used outdoors?
items.a: Absolutely. Travertine tiles, especially in tumbled and brushed finishes, are excellent for outdoor use. They are commonly installed in patios, garden paths, and pool decks due to their slip resistance and weather durability. Proper installation and sealing will maximize performance outdoors.

extra.q: What tile thickness do I need?
extra.a: Indoors, 10–12 mm works for most floors and walls. Outdoors or high-load areas may require 30 mm pavers. We’ll advise based on drawings.

extra.q: Are travertine tiles suitable for pool areas?
extra.a: Yes—tumbled or brushed finishes improve grip for wet zones. Combine with proper drainage and periodic sealing.

extra.q: What affects availability and lead times?
extra.a: Availability and lead times depend on color grade, finish, size, thickness, and order volume. Share a BOQ and destination port so we can plan the right supply flow.

extra.q: How often should I reseal?
extra.a: Typically every 12–24 months depending on exposure and traffic. Kitchens and outdoors may need more frequent care.

tumbled-travertine.intro: Tumbled travertine is a natural stone finish that provides a rustic, antique appearance. This finish is highly valued for its authenticity and charm, often chosen for Mediterranean-inspired interiors and outdoor applications such as patios, pool decks, and courtyards. Tumbled travertine creates warm, inviting spaces with timeless character.

lead.rest: This guide shows where rustic, textured travertine excels—patios, pool decks, garden paths and wall accents. Learn thickness, slip rating, freeze-thaw durability and sealing. As a quarry-backed Turkish travertine supplier, we provide FOB/CIF/EXW export with photo-documented loading.

features.intro: The tumbling process involves placing travertine pieces in a drum with abrasives to wear down edges and create a weathered effect. This produces irregular, textured surfaces that are slip-resistant and aesthetically rustic. Tumbled travertine blends perfectly with traditional, antique or Mediterranean-style projects. Its natural pores and aged look provide an authentic old-world feel while offering practical performance in wet and outdoor environments.

items.blurb: Aged, rustic look with softened edges and textured surface that mimics antique stone.
Textured surface enhances grip, making tumbled travertine safe for wet or outdoor spaces.
Complements Mediterranean, rustic, and antique-inspired designs with timeless charm.

applications.intro: Tumbled travertine is used in both indoor and outdoor projects where a rustic, antique look is desired. Outdoors, it is popular for pool decks, patios, pathways, and garden courtyards thanks to its slip resistance. Indoors, it enhances bathrooms, kitchens, and entryways with old-world style. Designers also use tumbled travertine for feature walls, fireplaces, and accent borders, creating unique visual impact with authentic stone character.

Tumbled travertine adds character to garden walls and indoor feature walls. Combine with honed or polished elements for contrast.

specs.intro: Tumbled travertine is available in tiles, pavers, and mosaics. Standard tile thickness ranges from 10–12 mm for indoor use, while outdoor pavers are produced in 30–50 mm thickness for durability. install.intro: Tumbled travertine should be installed with cement-based adhesives indoors and on compacted sand or mortar outdoors. Sealing is essential to protect from stains and moisture. Proper care preserves both the beauty and performance of tumbled travertine for years.
